188	@register
189	class CollectionCoordinator(Agent):
190	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
191	
192	    def __init__(self, ctx):
193	        super().__init__(ctx)
194	        self.tried: set[str] = set()
195	        self.attempts: dict[str, int] = {}
196	        self.running: dict[asyncio.Task, str] = {}      # follow-up job -> its site role
197	        self.history: list[dict] = []
198	        self.first_pass_end: dict[str, float] = {}
199	
200	    def ready(self) -> set[str]:
201	        """Sites whose first pass and analysis are done (gaps can be judged)."""
202	        return {role for role, keys in READY.items() if all(self.ctx.board.get(k) is not None for k in keys)}
203	
204	    def settled(self) -> set[str]:
205	        """Ready sites, plus sites whose analysis has not finished SETTLE_S after the first pass (it failed)."""
206	        now = self.ctx.elapsed()
207	        for role, (done_key, _) in READY.items():
208	            if self.ctx.board.get(done_key) is not None:
209	                self.first_pass_end.setdefault(role, now)
210	        return self.ready() | {r for r, t in self.first_pass_end.items() if now - t > SETTLE_S}
211	
212	    def saved_topics(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
213	        return {role: sorted({str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, role)} - {""})
214	                for role in READY}
215	
216	    async def plan(self, gaps: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
217	        board = self.ctx.board
218	        summaries = {k: str(v)[:600] for k, v in board.results.items() if k.endswith(".summary")}
219	        prompt = {"tender_reference": (board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference"),
220	                  "scenario_date": (board.get("brief") or {}).get("scenario_date"),
221	                  "gaps": gaps, "sites": {r: SITES[r] for r in {g["role"] for g in gaps}},
222	                  "saved_topics": self.saved_topics(), "first_pass_summaries": summaries,
223	                  "observed_pages": [{"source": e.source or e.data.get("url"), "text": e.data.get("text", "")[:1800]}
224	                                     for role in {g["role"] for g in gaps} for e in pages(self.ctx, role)[-3:]],
225	                  "earlier_followups": self.history[-8:], "site_tips": board.get("tips") or {}}
226	        reply = await self.ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, json.dumps(prompt, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), think=True)
227	        jobs, per_role = [], {}
228	        known = {g["id"]: g for g in gaps}
229	        for j in (reply or {}).get("jobs") or []:
230	            role = j.get("role")
231	            ids = [i for i in j.get("gaps") or [] if i in known and known[i]["role"] == role]
232	            if role not in READY or not ids or not str(j.get("job") or "").strip():
233	                continue
234	            if per_role.get(role, 0) >= MAX_JOBS_PER_ROLE or len(jobs) >= MAX_JOBS:
235	                continue
236	            per_role[role] = per_role.get(role, 0) + 1
237	            jobs.append({"role": role, "gaps": ids, "job": str(j["job"]).strip()})
238	        skipped = []
239	        for item in (reply or {}).get("skipped") or []:
240	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("id") not in known:
241	                continue
242	            gid = item["id"]
243	            if gid == "tender positions" or gid.startswith("spec requirement "):
244	                continue
245	            quote = " ".join(str(item.get("quote") or "").split())
246	            if len(quote) >= 12 and any(
247	                item.get("source") == (e.source or e.data.get("url"))
248	                and quote in " ".join(str(e.data.get("text") or "").split())
249	                for e in pages(self.ctx, known[gid]["role"])
250	            ):
251	                skipped.append(gid)
252	        if skipped:
253	            self.log.info("gaps skipped by the model: %s", skipped)
254	        self.tried |= set(skipped)
255	        return jobs
256	
257	    async def work(self, job: dict) -> None:
258	        reserve = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_S
259	        try:
260	            out = await run_job(self.ctx, job["role"], job["job"], max_steps=JOB_STEPS, stop_reserve=reserve)
261	            self.history.append({"role": job["role"], "gaps": job["gaps"], "done": out.get("done"),
262	                                 "summary": str(out.get("summary"))[:300]})
263	            self.log.info("follow-up %s %s done=%s: %s", job["role"], job["gaps"], out.get("done"),
264	                          str(out.get("summary"))[:200])
265	        except Exception as error:
266	            self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"follow-up {job['gaps']}: {error}")
267	            self.tried.difference_update(job["gaps"])
268	        if not locals().get("out", {}).get("done"):
269	            self.tried.difference_update(job["gaps"])
270	        await refresh(self.ctx, {job["role"]})
271	
272	    async def run(self) -> None:
273	        try:
274	            while True:
275	                ready = self.settled()
276	                if self.ctx.time_left() > ROUND_MIN_S:
277	                    gaps = [g for g in find_gaps(self.ctx.board, ready, self.saved_topics()) if g["id"] not in self.tried and self.attempts.get(g["id"], 0) < 2]
278	                    busy = set(self.running.values())
279	                    gaps = [g for g in gaps if g["role"] not in busy]     # a site with follow-ups running: wait for them
280	                    if gaps:
281	                        self.log.info("gaps: %s", [g["id"] for g in gaps])
282	                        try:
283	                            jobs = await self.plan(gaps)
284	                        except Exception as error:
285	                            self.log.warning("planning failed: %s", error)
286	                            jobs = []
287	                        for job in jobs:
288	                            for gid in job["gaps"]:
289	                                self.attempts[gid] = self.attempts.get(gid, 0) + 1
290	                            self.tried.update(job["gaps"])
291	                            task = asyncio.create_task(self.work(job))
292	                            self.running[task] = job["role"]
293	                            task.add_done_callback(lambda t: self.running.pop(t, None))
294	                all_done = self.settled() == set(READY)
295	                if self.running:
296	                    await asyncio.wait(list(self.running), timeout=5)
297	                    continue
298	                pending = [g for g in find_gaps(self.ctx.board, ready, self.saved_topics())
299	                           if g["id"] not in self.tried and self.attempts.get(g["id"], 0) < 2]
300	                if (all_done and not pending) or self.ctx.time_left() <= ROUND_MIN_S:
301	                    gaps = find_gaps(self.ctx.board, set(READY), self.saved_topics())
302	                    await self.ctx.board.set("gaps", gaps)
303	                    self.log.info("collect complete; open gaps: %s", [g["id"] for g in gaps])
304	                    return
305	                await asyncio.sleep(5)
306	        finally:
307	            tasks = list(self.running)
308	            for task in tasks:
309	                task.cancel()
310	            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

6	
7	When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
8	Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works

11	import asyncio
12	
13	from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
14	from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
15	from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
16	from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
17	from swarm.extract import brief_intro
18	from swarm.sites import site_for

24	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
25	    role: str = ""
26	    site_id: str = ""
27	    max_steps: int = 40
28	    hints: str = ""
29	
30	    def goal(self) -> str:
31	        raise NotImplementedError
32	
33	    def login_text(self) -> str:
34	        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
35	        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
36	        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"
37	
38	    def task_text(self) -> str:
39	        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
40	        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
41	                 if facts.get(k)}
42	        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
43	            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"
44	
45	    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
46	        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
47	        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
48	                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
49	
50	    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
51	        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
52	        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
53	        kwargs.setdefault("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
54	        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
55	                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
56	                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
57	        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
58	        return out

60	    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
61	        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
62	        is already saved, while time allows."""
63	        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
64	        records = []
65	        for attempt in range(attempts):
66	            note = ""
67	            if attempt:
68	                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
69	                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
70	                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
71	            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
72	            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
73	            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
74	            if self.site_id in rejected:
75	                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
76	                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
77	                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
78	                out["done"] = False
79	            if out["done"] or self.ctx.seconds_left() - kwargs.get("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S) < 120:
80	                break
81	        return {**out, "records": records}

83	    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
84	                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
85	        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
86	        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
87	        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
88	            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
89	            try:
90	                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
91	            except Exception as error:
92	                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
93	                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
94	            finally:
95	                await tab.close()
96	        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))
97	
98	    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
99	        try:
100	            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
101	        except TimeoutError:
102	            return {}
103	
104	    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
105	        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
106	        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
107	        return []
108	
109	    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
110	        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))
111	
112	    async def run(self) -> None:
113	        try:
114	            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
115	            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
116	            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
117	            for keywords, job in self.required():
118	                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
119	                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
120	                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
121	        finally:
122	            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)
123	
124	
125	def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
126	    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
127	    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)
128	
129	
130	async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
131	    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
132	    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
133	    cls = scraper_class(role)
134	    if cls is None:
135	        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
136	    scraper = cls(ctx)
137	    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
138	    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
139	    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
140	    if not main.locked():
141	        async with main:
142	            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
143	    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works
in the browser's main tab.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
        is already saved, while time allows."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
            if self.site_id in rejected:
                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
                out["done"] = False
            if out["done"] or self.ctx.seconds_left() - kwargs.get("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S) < 120:
                break
        return {**out, "records": records}

    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
            try:
                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
            finally:
                await tab.close()
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            for keywords, job in self.required():
                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)


def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked():
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py). While waiting, the main tab of browser 2 logs in and
passes the ERP's gates. Then the work runs as small jobs on up to ERP_TABS tabs of browser 2 (they share the login):

1. search: one job per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe): search it, save the result list. Nothing else.
2. As soon as a list is saved, the materials on it that fit a requirement (agents/analyze_materials.search_candidates:
   bore, pressure, mounting, certification equal where shown; stroke equal or covering the usable travel) become three
   jobs each, run in parallel: record (all tabs incl. status and lead times), prices (condition records with the
   quantity-scale register open) and stock (storage-location level).
   A material whose record turns out blocked gets no price/stock job (they wait behind the record jobs).

Small jobs finish inside their step budget (one big job per group used to run out of steps before prices and stock),
and no step is spent on materials the list already rules out. results["done.erp"] is set when the queue is empty.
"""
import os
import asyncio
import itertools

from agents.analyze_materials import extract_erp, merge_materials, search_candidates
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 60    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page
ERP_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ERP_TABS", "4"))   # parallel ERP jobs (main tab included); was 8: the 4-vCPU
#   sandbox stalled every browser at once (state capture timeouts), locally the same run did not

HINTS = ("Adapt to the observed software; these are possible patterns, not requirements. ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (start page / menu lists transactions for material display, stock "
         "overview, price conditions); system notice or access gate after login (copy displayed number exactly - "
         "read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; slider/robot gate passes with ONE fill_form: "
         "slider = its maximum (e.g. 100), robot checkbox = true, then the number and confirmation checkbox, then_click "
         "continue button); material search help (F4) lists results only for narrow search term; records with several "
         "tabs/registers (basic data, technical data, planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity "
         "scales; stock per plant and per storage location); status codes explained in legend or tooltip; short session "
         "timeout - log in again when login page appears. Save steps: once you see the links of a record's "
         "tabs/registers, read all with ONE read_page(urls=[...]); transactions often take the material number "
         "directly in their entry field.")

SEARCH, RECORD, PRICES, STOCK = 0, 1, 2, 2       # job priorities: searches first, then records, then prices/stock


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def describe(item: dict) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])


def search_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    term = item["group"] or "the attributes"
    return (f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{describe(item)}\n"
            "1. Log in if needed, open material search (search help of material display transaction).\n"
            f"2. Search {term}; read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}' (all result pages "
            "via next_page_link).\n"
            "3. done, listing the materials of the list with their attributes. Do NOT open records (other agents do).")


def material_goal(job: str, material: str, item: dict) -> str:
    group = f" (catalogue group {item['group']})" if item.get("group") else ""
    find = (f"Open material {material}{group}: type the number into the transaction's material field, or search "
            f"{item.get('group') or material} in its search help and click the row of {material}.")
    if job == "record":
        return (f"{find}\nread_page EVERY tab/register of its record (basic data, technical data, planning/status with "
                f"lead times and status; status legend or tooltip too) with topic 'erp material {material}', in one "
                "read_page(urls=[...]) when the tabs are links. done with status and lead times.")
    if job == "prices":
        return (f"Price conditions of material {material}{group}: open the price condition display transaction for "
                f"it, open its quantity-scale register so every scale row shows, read_page with topic 'erp prices "
                f"{material}'; several condition records (validity periods) -> read each one (next_page_link = exact "
                "text of link to next record). done with validity periods and scale prices.")
    return (f"Stock of material {material}{group}: open the stock overview transaction for it, open storage-location "
            f"level so quantity per location and stock type shows, read_page with topic 'erp stock {material}'. done "
            "with freely usable quantity per location.")


async def _items(ctx) -> list[dict]:
    requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
    used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
            for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
    if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
        requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
    items = work_items(requirements)
    await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
    return items


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 16
    hints = HINTS

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        super().__init__(ctx)
        self.queue: asyncio.PriorityQueue = asyncio.PriorityQueue()
        self.pending = 0
        self.producer_done = False
        self.seen: set = set()
        self._order = itertools.count()

    def add(self, priority: int, job: tuple) -> None:
        key = job[:2] if job[0] != "search" else ("search", job[1]["group"], repr(job[1]["requirements"]))
        if key in self.seen:
            return
        self.seen.add(key)
        self.pending += 1
        self.queue.put_nowait((priority, next(self._order), job))

    def blocked(self, material: str) -> bool:
        """True if the material's record page (read meanwhile) says it is blocked: its prices and stock are not needed."""
        info = merge_materials(list(self.ctx.shared.get("erp.extracted", {}).values())).get(norm_ref(material)) or {}
        return info.get("is_active") is False

    async def extract_job(self, out: dict) -> dict:
        evidence = []
        for record in out.get("records") or []:
            data = record.get("data") or {}
            text = data.get("text") or data.get("_observed_text")
            if text:
                evidence.append(Evidence("erp.page", self.site_id,
                    {**data, "text": text, "url": data.get("url") or record.get("source"),
                     "topic": data.get("topic") or record.get("kind", "")}))
        return await extract_erp(self.ctx, evidence=evidence)

    async def do(self, job: tuple, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        stop = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_TIME_S
        if job[0] == "search":
            item = job[1]
            out = await self.browse_until_done(search_goal(item), attempts=2, tab=tab, max_steps=14, stop_reserve=stop)
            found = search_candidates(await self.extract_job(out), item)
            self.log.info("search %s: candidates %s", item["group"], found)
            for material in found:
                self.add(RECORD, ("record", material, item))
            return
        kind, material, item = job
        if kind != "record" and self.blocked(material):
            self.log.info("%s %s skipped: material blocked", kind, material)
            return
        out = await self.browse_until_done(material_goal(kind, material, item), attempts=2, tab=tab, max_steps=16,
                                     stop_reserve=stop)
        await self.extract_job(out)
        if kind == "record" and not self.blocked(material):
            self.add(PRICES, ("prices", material, item))
            self.add(STOCK, ("stock", material, item))

    async def worker(self, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        """Takes jobs until the queue is empty and no running job can add more (or time is up)."""
        try:
            while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                try:
                    _, _, job = self.queue.get_nowait()
                except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                    if self.pending <= 0 and self.producer_done:
                        return
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                    continue
                try:
                    await self.do(job, tab)
                except Exception as error:
                    self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{job[0]} {job[1] if job[0] != 'search' else job[1]['group']}: "
                                                    f"{error}")
                finally:
                    self.pending -= 1
        finally:
            if tab is not None:
                await tab.close()

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, open material search "
                                  "help of material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. done once search form open.",
                                  max_steps=12)
            async def produce():
                try:
                    while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                        for item in await _items(self.ctx):
                            self.add(SEARCH, ("search", item))
                        if self.ctx.board.get("requirements_final"):
                            return
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)
                finally:
                    self.producer_done = True
            async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
                group.create_task(produce())
                group.create_task(self.worker(None))
                for _ in range(ERP_TABS - 1):
                    group.create_task(self.worker(Tab(self.browser)))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

2	it hands and eyes. This module only wires it to our setup: the run's CDP browsers, the Qwen proxy, no telemetry, navigation
3	limited to the task's websites, and three actions of our own:
4	
5	- `read_page`: extract the full text of the page the model chose (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels),
6	  optionally open a URL first and follow a "next page" link the model names; with a `topic` the text is kept as evidence.
7	- `record`: save one fact the model read.
8	- `fill_form`: set several fields of the current form at once (helper for long forms such as the bid configurator).
9	- `share_tip`: pass a short how-to for the site to later agents on it (they get the tips in their hints).
10	
11	Next to every agent a PopupGuard (swarm/guard.py) clears cookie banners, surveys, notices, error pages and access gates,
12	so the agent's steps and context go to the data. read_page does not open a page another agent already saved.

19	different tabs. An agent only sees its own tab and tabs nobody owns (e.g. a popup it opened), never another agent's.

320	                *(c.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": t}) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True))

367	                return True
368	
369	        verdicts = await asyncio.gather(*(hung(t) for t in pages))
370	        closed: list[str] = []
371	        for target, is_hung in zip(pages, verdicts):
372	            if is_hung:
373	                try:
374	                    await asyncio.wait_for(client.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": target["targetId"]}), 5)
375	                    _OWNERS.pop(target["targetId"], None)
376	                    closed.append(target["targetId"])
377	                    log.warning("browser %d: closed a hung tab (%s)", browser, str(target.get("url"))[:80])
378	                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
379	                    continue
380	        return closed
381	
382	    if not browsers.cdp_urls():
383	        return []
384	    try:
385	        return await asyncio.wait_for(_with_cdp(browser, probe), TAB_PROBE_S + 15)
386	    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
387	        log.debug("hung-tab check on browser %d failed: %s", browser, error)
388	        return []

391	async def responsive_tab(tab: "Tab") -> "Tab":
392	    """The tab to work in: `tab` if its browser answers, else a new tab of the next browser that does. Any browser can
393	    open any site, so one dead browser must not take a whole role (or the signing) down with it."""
394	    urls = browsers.cdp_urls()
395	    if not urls:
396	        return tab
397	    if await browser_responds(tab.browser):
398	        closed = await close_hung_tabs(tab.browser)
399	        if tab.target_id and tab.target_id in closed:
400	            log.warning("browser %d: this agent's tab was hung and closed; continuing in a new tab", tab.browser)
401	            return Tab(tab.browser)
402	        return tab
403	    for step in range(1, len(urls)):
404	        other = (tab.browser + step) % len(urls)
405	        if await browser_responds(other):
406	            log.warning("browser %d is unreachable: continuing in a new tab of browser %d", tab.browser, other)
407	            return Tab(other)
408	    return tab   # none answers: try the original again (the caller's retry logic takes over)

419	    """The tab a target belongs to: its own claim, else the owner of the tab that opened it (popup of a popup too)."""

432	def _visible_page_targets(self) -> list:
433	    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then popups its pages opened; never another
434	    agent's tab or popups. A tab nobody owns and no owned tab opened (the browser's first tab) is visible only to the
435	    browser's main tab, which claims it. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""

441	    rest = [t for t in targets if t.target_id != tab.target_id
442	            and (owner_of(t.target_id) is tab or (owner_of(t.target_id) is None and tab.main))]
443	    return mine + rest

463	async def _enable_page_monitoring_routed(self, cdp_session) -> None:
464	    """browser-use registers one lifecycle handler per page target, but the CDP client keeps only ONE handler per event
465	    (the last one), and that handler drops events of every other target. With several tabs in a browser, navigations
466	    in all but the last-attached tab then waited for load events that never came (3-8 s per navigation). Here one
467	    handler per client routes each event to the queue of its own target."""
468	    await _enable_page_monitoring(self, cdp_session)
469	    events = getattr(cdp_session, "_lifecycle_events", None)
470	    if events is None:
471	        return
472	    routes = self.__dict__.setdefault("_lifecycle_routes", {})
473	    routes[cdp_session.target_id] = events
474	
475	    def route(event, session_id=None):
476	        target = self.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if session_id else None
477	        queue = routes.get(target)
478	        if queue is not None:
479	            queue.append({"name": event.get("name", "unknown"), "loaderId": event.get("loaderId", "none"),
480	                          "timestamp": asyncio.get_event_loop().time()})
481	
482	    cdp_session.cdp_client.register.Page.lifecycleEvent(route)
483

488	class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
489	    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once.
490	    It works in its own `Tab` (set `_tab` before starting), with focus emulation on: with several windows only one has
491	    the OS focus, and in the others typed text and focus-dependent page scripts did nothing (logins "did not register",
492	    links "did not navigate"). Playwright enables the same emulation on every page for this reason."""
493	
494	    _tab: Any = PrivateAttr(default=None)
495	    _focus_emulated: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
496	    _dialogs_handled: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
497	    _state_timeouts: int = PrivateAttr(default=0)
498	    _dialog_tasks: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
499	    _dialog_pending: dict = PrivateAttr(default_factory=dict)
500	
501	    async def get_browser_state_summary(self, include_screenshot: bool = True, cached: bool = False,
502	                                        include_recent_events: bool = False):
503	        try:
504	            async with asyncio.timeout(30):
505	                state = await super().get_browser_state_summary(
506	                    include_screenshot=include_screenshot, cached=cached, include_recent_events=include_recent_events)
507	            self._state_timeouts = 0
508	            return state
509	        except TimeoutError as error:
510	            self._state_timeouts += 1
511	            raise RuntimeError('Browser state capture timed out after 30s; retry observation before acting') from error
512	
513	    async def connect(self, cdp_url: str | None = None):
514	        await super().connect(cdp_url)
515	        tab, focus = self._tab, self.agent_focus_target_id
516	        if tab is not None and focus and tab.target_id != focus:
517	            alive = {t.target_id for t in _all_page_targets(self.session_manager)}
518	            if tab.target_id not in alive:      # a main tab's first use, or the agent closed its tab: adopt this one
519	                _OWNERS.pop(tab.target_id or "", None)
520	                tab.popups.discard(focus)
521	                tab.claim(focus)
522	        if tab is not None and focus:
523	            await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(focus, focus=True)     # turns focus emulation on for the tab
524	        return self
525	
526	    async def get_or_create_cdp_session(self, target_id=None, focus: bool = True):
527	        session = await super().get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=focus)
528	        if focus and self._tab is not None:
529	            self._tab.adopt(session.target_id)      # the agent went into a popup of its tab: keep others out
530	        if focus and self._tab is not None and session.session_id not in self._focus_emulated:
531	            self._focus_emulated.add(session.session_id)
532	            try:
533	                await session.cdp_client.send.Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(
534	                    params={"enabled": True}, session_id=session.session_id)
535	            except Exception as error:
536	                log.debug("focus emulation failed: %s", error)
537	        if focus and session.session_id not in self._dialogs_handled:
538	            self._dialogs_handled.add(session.session_id)
539	            await self._handle_dialogs(session)
540	        return session
541	
542	    async def _handle_dialogs(self, session) -> None:
543	        """Accept native JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm such as "submit binding bid?", beforeunload) in the agent's
544	        tab. browser-use registers this per new tab, but its handler missed the bid wizard's final confirm: the page
545	        then froze, every page script and state read waited for the dialog, and the run ended without an answer."""
546	        root = self._cdp_client_root or session.cdp_client
547	
548	        async def dismiss(event, session_id=None):
549	            kind, message = event.get("type", "alert"), event.get("message", "")
550	            try:
551	                self._closed_popup_messages.append(f"[{kind}] {message}")
552	            except Exception:
553	                pass
554	            log.info("accepting %s dialog: %s", kind, message[:120])
555	            try:
556	                await asyncio.wait_for(root.send.Page.handleJavaScriptDialog(
557	                    params={"accept": kind != "prompt"}, session_id=session_id or session.session_id), 5)
558	                return True
559	            except Exception as error:
560	                log.debug("dialog handling failed: %s", error)
561	                return False
562	
563	        def target_for(session_id):
564	            manager = self.session_manager
565	            return (manager.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if manager and session_id else None) or getattr(session, "target_id", session_id)
566	
567	        def on_closed(event, session_id=None):
568	            target = target_for(session_id or session.session_id)
569	            for key in list(self._dialog_pending):
570	                if key[0] == target:
571	                    self._dialog_pending.pop(key, None)
572	
573	        def on_dialog(event, session_id=None):
574	            # cdp-use awaits async callbacks inside its sole WebSocket receive loop. Waiting for a CDP
575	            # response there prevents that very response from being received and stalls page observation.
576	            key = (target_for(session_id or session.session_id), event.get("type"), event.get("message"))
577	            if key in self._dialog_pending:
578	                return
579	            task = asyncio.create_task(dismiss(event, session_id))
580	            self._dialog_pending[key] = task
581	            self._dialog_tasks.add(task)
582	            def finished(done):
583	                self._dialog_tasks.discard(done)
584	                if done.cancelled() or done.exception() or not done.result():
585	                    if self._dialog_pending.get(key) is done:
586	                        self._dialog_pending.pop(key, None)
587	            task.add_done_callback(finished)
588	        try:
589	            session.cdp_client.register.Page.javascriptDialogOpening(on_dialog)
590	            session.cdp_client.register.Page.javascriptDialogClosed(on_closed)
591	            await session.cdp_client.send.Page.enable(session_id=session.session_id)
592	        except Exception as error:
593	            log.debug("dialog handler not registered: %s", error)
594	
595	    async def _navigate_and_wait(self, url, target_id, timeout=None, wait_until="load"):
596	        try:
597	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
598	        except RuntimeError as error:
599	            if "timed out" not in str(error):
600	                raise
601	            log.warning("navigation stuck, stopping the old load and retrying: %s", url)
602	            session = await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=False)
603	            try:
604	                await asyncio.wait_for(session.cdp_client.send.Page.stopLoading(session_id=session.session_id), 5)
605	            except Exception as stop_error:
606	                log.debug("stopLoading failed: %s", stop_error)
607	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
608

657	async def _drag(browser_session: BrowserSession, x0: float, x1: float, y: float) -> None:

725	async def browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
726	                 max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
727	                 stop_reserve: float | None = None, extra_tools=None, max_actions_per_step: int = 4,
728	                 flash: bool = True, careful: bool = False, dedupe_reads: bool = True,
729	                 stop_on_record: str = "") -> dict:
730	    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.
731	
732	    `tab`: the tab to work in (default: the main tab of `browser`). Screenshots are off by default
733	    (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page` already reads canvas labels and
734	    hidden text. `flash`: short replies + compact prompt (see module doc). `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this
735	    many seconds left (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)` may register more actions. Pages read with a
736	    `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
737	    A PopupGuard (swarm/guard.py) clears popups, notices and error pages next to the agent; `careful=True` limits it to
738	    noise without inputs (the bid submitter). `dedupe_reads`: read_page of a URL another agent already saved returns
739	    the saved text instead of opening it again (off for mails that change, such as TANs).
740	    """
741	    records: list[dict] = []
742	    reserve = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S if stop_reserve is None else stop_reserve
743	
744	    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
745	        records.append(rec)
746	        if on_record:
747	            await on_record(rec)
748	
749	    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit, dedupe_reads=dedupe_reads, stop_on_record=stop_on_record)
750	    if extra_tools:
751	        extra_tools(tools)
752	
753	    tab = await responsive_tab(tab or main_tab(browser))
754	    await tab.open()
755	    session = make_session(ctx, tab, vision=bool(use_vision))
756	    prompt = dict(flash_mode=True, override_system_message=FLASH_SYSTEM.format(max_actions=max_actions_per_step)) \
757	        if flash else {}
758	    tips = site_tips(ctx, site_id)
759	    hints = hints + ("\nTips from other agents on this site:\n- " + "\n- ".join(tips) if tips else "")
760	    # A tab an agent already worked in is on the site (logged in, past gates): start from its current page instead of
761	    # browser-use opening the site's start URL from the goal again.
762	    reused = tab.used and bool(browsers.cdp_urls())
763	    tab.used = True
764	    browsing_llm = make_llm(flash)
765	    browsing_llm._usage_ctx = ctx
766	    agent = Agent(task=goal + ("\n\nThis tab is already on the site: start from the current page." if reused else ""),
767	                  llm=browsing_llm, browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
768	                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
769	                  llm_timeout=CALL_TIMEOUT_S + 2, step_timeout=120, directly_open_url=not reused,
770	                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""), **prompt)
771	    guard = PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=careful,
772	                       fill=lambda pairs, then_click, item_id: fill_page(session, pairs, "", then_click, item_id))
773	    evaluate = lambda js, *a: _evaluate(session, js, *a)  # noqa: E731
774	    guard_task: asyncio.Task | None = None
775	
776	    async def before_step(_agent) -> None:
777	        nonlocal guard_task
778	        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve:
779	            agent.stop()
780	            return
781	        try:                    # the page the model is about to see: cleared first
782	            await asyncio.wait_for(guard.sweep(evaluate), 25)
783	        except Exception as error:
784	            log.debug("guard before step failed: %s", error)
785	        if guard_task is None:  # from now on also between steps (popups that appear while the model thinks)
786	            guard_task = asyncio.create_task(guard.loop(evaluate))
787	
788	    secrets = [str((s.get("credentials") or {}).get("password") or "") for s in (ctx.task.get("access") or [])] \
789	        if ctx is not None else []
790	
791	    async def after_step(_agent) -> None:
792	        try:
793	            line = _step_line(agent)
794	            for secret in secrets:        # the model's memory sometimes repeats the login
795	                if len(secret) >= 4:
796	                    line = line.replace(secret, "***")
797	            log.info("%s step %d: %s", author, agent.state.n_steps - 1, line)
798	        except Exception as error:
799	            log.debug("step line failed: %s", error)
800	        if session._state_timeouts >= 2:
801	            log.warning("%s: repeated browser-state timeouts; ending this connection so the caller can reattach", author)
802	            agent.stop()
803	
804	    try:
805	        async with asyncio.timeout(max(1, ctx.seconds_left() - reserve)):
806	            history = await agent.run(max_steps=max_steps, on_step_start=before_step, on_step_end=after_step)
807	    except TimeoutError:
808	        history = agent.history
809	    finally:
810	        if guard_task is not None:
811	            guard_task.cancel()
812	            await asyncio.gather(guard_task, return_exceptions=True)
813	        try:
814	            async with asyncio.timeout(8):
815	                await session.kill() if not browsers.cdp_urls() else await session.stop()
816	        except TimeoutError:
817	            log.warning("browser cleanup exceeded its budget for %s", author)
818	        finally:
819	            tasks = list(session._dialog_tasks)
820	            for task in tasks:
821	                task.cancel()
822	            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
823	            if browsing_llm._sdk_client is not None:
824	                await browsing_llm._sdk_client.close()
825	    summary = history.final_result() or ("Browser state repeatedly timed out; reattach to the existing tab and inspect it"
826	                                         if session._state_timeouts >= 2 else "")
827	    return {"summary": summary, "records": records, "steps": len(history.history),
828	            "done": history.is_done() and history.is_successful() is True,
