1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: calculator (plain code, no model)
2	# NEEDS: brief, tender, quantities, requirements, materials, erp, discount, mail   WRITES: results["bid"], results["answer"]
3	"""Deterministic pricing, lead times and allocations per the brief's rules. Every input that is missing only removes
4	the fields that depend on it: a position without material/price is omitted, an unknown surcharge leaves the
5	surcharge field blank, and so on (a signed partial bid beats nothing).
6	
7	results["bid"] = {"answer": <answer schema dict>, "omitted": [positions], "lines": [{position, display strings,
8	                  material attributes for the configurator, notes}], "issues": [str]}
9	results["answer"] = results["bid"]["answer"]
10	"""
11	import math
12	from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, Decimal
13	
14	from agents.analyze_quantities import withdrawn_numbers
15	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
16	from swarm.normalize import validity_end, de_number, norm_ref, round_cents, to_datetime, to_decimal
17	
18	D0 = Decimal(0)
19	
20	
21	def is_set_unit(unit) -> bool:
22	    u = str(unit or "").strip().lower()
23	    return u.startswith("satz") or u.startswith("set") or u.startswith("sätze")
24	
25	
26	def valid_condition(conditions: list[dict], material: str, scenario) -> dict | None:
27	    """The material's price condition valid on the scenario date (both endpoints inclusive); latest start wins."""
28	    if scenario is None:
29	        return None
30	    valid = []
31	    for c in conditions:
32	        if norm_ref(c.get("material")) != norm_ref(material):
33	            continue
34	        start, end = to_datetime(c.get("valid_from")), validity_end(c.get("valid_to"))
35	        if (c.get("valid_from") and start is None) or (c.get("valid_to") and end is None):
36	            continue
37	        if (start is None or start <= scenario) and (end is None or scenario <= end):
38	            valid.append((start or to_datetime("1970-01-01"), c))
39	    return max(valid, key=lambda x: x[0])[1] if valid else None
40	
41	
42	def scale_price(condition: dict, pieces: int) -> Decimal | None:
43	    """Per-piece price at the highest scale whose minimum quantity <= pieces, divided by the price unit."""
44	    fmt = condition.get("number_format")
45	    rows = []
46	    for s in condition.get("scales") or []:
47	        q, p = to_decimal(s.get("min_qty"), fmt), to_decimal(s.get("price"), fmt)
48	        if q is not None and p is not None and 0 <= q <= pieces and p >= 0:
49	            rows.append((q, p))
50	    if not rows:
51	        return None
52	    unit = to_decimal(condition.get("price_unit"))
53	    return max(rows)[1] / unit if unit is not None and unit > 0 else None
54	
55	
56	def allocate_cents(total: Decimal, weights: dict[str, Decimal]) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
57	    """Split `total` (EUR) proportionally in cents: floor, then remaining cents to the largest remainders,
58	    ties by ascending position identifier."""
59	    cents = int((total * 100).to_integral_value())
60	    wsum = sum(weights.values(), D0)
61	    if wsum <= 0 or not weights:
62	        return {k: D0 for k in weights}
63	    exact = {k: Decimal(cents) * w / wsum for k, w in weights.items()}
64	    floors = {k: int(v.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)) for k, v in exact.items()}
65	    rest = cents - sum(floors.values())
66	    order = sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(exact[k] - floors[k]), k))
67	    for k in order[:rest]:
68	        floors[k] += 1
69	    return {k: Decimal(v) / 100 for k, v in floors.items()}
70	
71	
72	def marginal_bonus(base_total: Decimal, bands: list[dict]) -> Decimal:
73	    credit = D0
74	    for b in bands:
75	        lo = to_decimal(b.get("from")) or D0
76	        hi = to_decimal(b.get("to")) if b.get("to") not in (None, "", "null") else None
77	        pct = to_decimal(b.get("percent")) or D0
78	        top = base_total if hi is None else min(base_total, hi)
79	        if top > lo:
80	            credit += (top - lo) * pct / 100
81	    return round_cents(credit)
82	
83	
84	def position_keys(clarifications: list[dict], position: str) -> dict:
85	    """Commercial keys and setup fee the latest Q&A answers assign to a position (withdrawn answers ignored)."""
86	    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
87	    keys, fee = {}, None
88	    ordered = sorted(clarifications, key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
89	    for c in ordered:
90	        if norm_ref(c.get("number")) in withdrawn or position not in [str(x).strip() for x in c.get("positions") or []]:
91	            continue
92	        for k, v in (c.get("keys") or {}).items():
93	            if v not in (None, "", "null"):
94	                keys[k] = v
95	        if c.get("setup_fee") not in (None, "", "null"):
96	            fee = to_decimal(c["setup_fee"], "de-DE" if "," in str(c["setup_fee"]) else None)
97	    return {"keys": keys, "setup_fee": fee}
98	
99	
100	def compute(inputs: dict) -> dict:
101	    brief, tender = inputs.get("brief") or {}, inputs.get("tender") or {}
102	    quantities, requirements = inputs.get("quantities") or {}, inputs.get("requirements") or {}
103	    matched, erp = inputs.get("materials") or {}, inputs.get("erp") or {}
104	    discount, mail = inputs.get("discount") or {}, inputs.get("mail") or {}
105	    scenario = to_datetime(brief.get("scenario_date"))
106	    erp_materials = {norm_ref(k): v for k, v in (erp.get("materials") or {}).items()}
107	    issues, omitted, lines = [], [], {}
108	    clarifications = tender.get("clarifications") or []
109	
110	    # 1. per position: pieces, material, EUR base price
111	    for p in tender.get("positions") or []:
112	        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
113	        q = (quantities.get(pos) or {}).get("quantity")
114	        req = next((v for k, v in requirements.items() if norm_ref(k) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), {}) or {}
115	        mat = (matched.get(pos) or {}).get("material")
116	        line = {"position": pos, "material": mat, "unit": p.get("unit"), "required": (matched.get(pos) or {}).get("required"),
117	                "short_text": p.get("short_text"), **position_keys(clarifications, pos)}
118	        lines[pos] = line
119	        if q is None:
120	            issues.append(f"{pos}: no quantity")
121	            continue
122	        if is_set_unit(p.get("unit")):
123	            per_set = to_decimal(req.get("pieces_per_set"))
124	            if not per_set:
125	                issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity in sets but pieces per set unknown")
126	                continue
127	            q = (to_decimal(q) * per_set) if to_decimal(q) is not None else None
128	        if to_decimal(q) is None or to_decimal(q) <= 0 or to_decimal(q) != int(to_decimal(q)):
129	            issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity must be a positive integer")
130	            continue
131	        line["pieces"] = int(q)
132	        if not mat:
133	            issues.append(f"{pos}: no material ({(matched.get(pos) or {}).get('reason')})")
134	            continue
135	        line["erp"] = erp_materials.get(norm_ref(mat), {})
136	        line["configuration"] = {k: line["erp"].get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")}
137	        cond = valid_condition(erp.get("conditions") or [], mat, scenario)
138	        price = scale_price(cond, int(q)) if cond else None
139	        if price is None:
140	            # say why: a missing condition, one outside the scenario date, or unreadable scales/price unit
141	            seen = [{k: c.get(k) for k in ("valid_from", "valid_to", "price_unit", "number_format", "currency")}
142	                    | {"scales": len(c.get("scales") or [])}
143	                    for c in erp.get("conditions") or [] if norm_ref(c.get("material")) == norm_ref(mat)]
144	            issues.append(f"{pos}: no valid price condition/scale for {mat}; conditions seen: {seen or 'none'}"
145	                          + (f"; chosen: {cond}" if cond else ""))
146	            continue
147	        currency = norm_ref((cond or {}).get("currency") or "EUR")
148	        if currency != "EUR":
149	            rate = to_decimal((mail.get("fx_by_key") or {}).get(norm_ref(cond.get("fx_key")), {}).get(currency)) if cond.get("fx_key") else to_decimal((mail.get("fx_fixing") or {}).get(currency))
150	            if rate is None:
151	                issues.append(f"{pos}: price in {currency}, no FX rate")
152	                continue
153	            price = price * rate
154	        line["base"] = round_cents(price)
155	        line["erp"] = erp_materials.get(norm_ref(mat), {})
156	        # the configurator lists the catalogue's own attribute values, so the submitter selects these
157	        line["configuration"] = {k: line["erp"].get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")}
158	
159	    priced = {pos: l for pos, l in lines.items() if "base" in l}
160	    omitted = [pos for pos in lines if pos not in priced]
161	
162	    # 2. order-level discount (threshold on undiscounted goods value of all priced positions)
163	    pct = to_decimal(discount.get("percent")) or D0
164	    threshold = to_decimal(discount.get("min_order_value"))
165	    order_value = round_cents(sum((l["pieces"] * l["base"] for l in priced.values()), D0))
166	    order_value_complete = len(priced) == len(lines)
167	    discount_unknown = threshold is not None and order_value < threshold and not order_value_complete
168	    if discount_unknown:
169	        issues.append("conditional discount unresolved: incomplete order value; 0% is a partial estimate")
170	    if threshold is not None and order_value < threshold:
171	        pct = D0
172	    d = pct / 100
173	
174	    # 3. shared setup pools, project bonus (allocations in cents)
175	    pools: dict[str, dict] = {}
176	    bonus: dict[str, dict] = {}
177	    for pos, l in lines.items():
178	        if l["keys"].get("setup_pool"):
179	            pools.setdefault(norm_ref(l["keys"]["setup_pool"]), {})[pos] = l
180	        if l["keys"].get("bonus_plan"):
181	            bonus.setdefault(norm_ref(l["keys"]["bonus_plan"]), {})[pos] = l
182	    for key, members in pools.items():
183	        fee = to_decimal((mail.get("setup_pools") or {}).get(key))
184	        masses = {pos: to_decimal(l.get("erp", {}).get("allocation_mass_g")) for pos, l in members.items()}
185	        weights = {pos: Decimal(l["pieces"]) * masses[pos] for pos, l in members.items()
186	                   if l.get("pieces") and masses[pos] is not None and masses[pos] >= 0}
187	        if fee is None or fee < 0 or len(weights) != len(members) or not any(weights.values()):

3	"""Turns the saved ERP pages into materials, price conditions and stock, then matches each position in code:
4	an ACTIVE material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification all equal the requirement exactly.
5	A requirement given as usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) gets twice the per-end reserve of the technical release for the
6	current revision added (amendments were already applied by the requirement analyst).
7	
8	Every saved page is extracted ONCE (cached in ctx.shared), with the shape its topic asks for (search list, material
9	record, price conditions, stock), so the ERP scraper can ask "which candidates did this search list show?" while it
10	works and the matcher and the coordinator's follow-up rounds only pay for new pages.
11	
12	Attributes read on a material's own record page beat values from a search list; its status (active / blocked) is only
13	taken from record pages, and record pages that disagree leave it unknown (never "blocked" by one misread).
14	Attributes a page does not show (e.g. certification in a search list) count as unverified, not as a mismatch.
15	
16	results["erp"] = {"materials": {no: {...}}, "conditions": [{...}], "stock": {no: {"free": "12", "locations": [...]}}}
17	results["materials"] = {position: {"material": no | None, "required": {...}, "candidates": [...], "reason": str,
18	                                   "unverified": [attribute, ...]}}

37	  "valid_from": "as shown", "valid_to": "as shown", "currency": "", "fx_key": null,
38	  "price_unit": "price unit quantity, e.g. 100", "number_format": "e.g. en-US or de-DE if stated",

81	def same(a, b) -> bool:
82	    x, y = num(a), num(b)
83	    if x is not None and y is not None:
84	        return x == y

92	    """Equal after normalisation; 'none required' and 'none' count as the same (no certification)."""
93	    x, y = norm_ref(a), norm_ref(b)
94	    if _NONE.match(x) and _NONE.match(y):

107	async def extract_erp(ctx, evidence=None) -> dict:
108	    """Extract every saved ERP page not extracted yet (one model call per page, in parallel); returns the cache
109	    {page key: {"kind", "topic", "url", "materials", "conditions", "stock"}}."""
110	    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("erp.extracted", {})
111	    todo = [e for e in (pages(ctx, "erp") if evidence is None else evidence) if _key(e) not in cache]
112	
113	    async def one(e) -> dict:
114	        # A slow unrelated page must not block a finished search from scheduling material records.
115	        async with ctx.lock(f"erp.extract.{_key(e)!r}"):
116	            if _key(e) in cache:
117	                return cache[_key(e)]
118	            kind = page_kind(e.data.get("topic"))
119	            shape, keys, instruction = SHAPES[kind]
120	            out = await extract(ctx, instruction, shape, [page_block(e)], list_key=keys, chunk_size=25_000)
121	            result = {"kind": kind, "topic": e.data.get("topic"), "url": e.data.get("url"), "_incomplete": out.get("_incomplete", False),
122	                    **{k: out.get(k) or [] for k in ("materials", "conditions", "stock")}}
123	            if not result["_incomplete"]:
124	                cache[_key(e)] = result
125	                await publish(ctx, cache)
126	            return result
127	    replies = await asyncio.gather(*(one(e) for e in todo), return_exceptions=True)
128	    for r in replies:
129	        if isinstance(r, Exception):
130	            ctx.board.error("MaterialMatcher", f"ERP extraction: {type(r).__name__}")

134	def merge_materials(extracted: list[dict], groups=()) -> dict:
135	    """{material no: attributes}: record pages first (they win), then search lists fill what is still missing.
136	    Status only from record pages; record pages that disagree on it leave it unknown. A material listed on the search
137	    page of a catalogue group (`groups`: the requirements' groups, named in the page topic) belongs to that group."""
138	    out: dict = {}
139	    status: dict[str, set] = {}
140	    order = sorted(reversed(extracted), key=lambda x: 0 if x.get("kind") == "record" else 1 if x.get("kind") == "any" else 2)
141	    for page in order:
142	        from_record = page.get("kind") in ("record", "any")
143	        for r in page.get("materials") or []:
144	            no = norm_ref(r.get("material"))
145	            if not no:
146	                continue
147	            cur = out.setdefault(no, {"material": str(r.get("material")).strip(), "seen_in": set()})
148	            cur["seen_in"].add(page.get("kind"))
149	            for k, v in r.items():
150	                if k == "is_active":
151	                    continue
152	                if not blank(v) and blank(cur.get(k)):
153	                    cur[k] = v
154	            if page.get("kind") == "list" and blank(cur.get("kataloggruppe")):
155	                topic = norm_ref(page.get("topic"))
156	                group = next((g for g in groups if norm_ref(g) and norm_ref(g) in topic), None)
157	                if group:

175	def merge_condition_fragments(conditions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
176	    """One condition read on several pages (header with validity / price unit, a separate scales register) arrives as
177	    fragments. A fragment without validity dates fills what the material's single dated condition lacks. Without this,
178	    the dated header (no scales) won as 'latest valid' and the position went unpriced (run_7732ba545b50b3a5, 01.05).
179	    Ambiguous cases (several dated conditions without scales) stay as they are."""
180	    def dated(c):
181	        return bool(c.get("valid_from") or c.get("valid_to"))
182	
183	    out = [dict(c) for c in conditions]
184	    for material in {norm_ref(c.get("material")) for c in out}:
185	        mine = [c for c in out if norm_ref(c.get("material")) == material]
186	        fragments = [c for c in mine if not dated(c)]
187	        targets = [c for c in mine if dated(c) and any(not c.get(k) for k in FILLABLE)]
188	        if not fragments or len(targets) != 1:
189	            continue
190	        target = targets[0]
191	        for frag in fragments:
192	            for key in FILLABLE:
193	                if not target.get(key) and frag.get(key):
194	                    target[key] = frag[key]
195	        if target.get("scales"):
196	            out = [c for c in out if not any(c is f for f in fragments)]
197	    return out

216	def required_stroke(req: dict, mail: dict, current_revision: str) -> Decimal | None:
217	    stroke = num(req.get("stroke"))
218	    if stroke is None or req.get("stroke_kind") != "usable":
219	        return stroke
220	    releases = (mail or {}).get("technical_release") or {}
221	    key = norm_ref(req.get("reserve_key"))

223	    if match is None:
224	        same_rev = [r for r in releases.values() if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current_revision)]
225	        match = same_rev[0] if len(same_rev) == 1 else None
226	    if match and norm_ref(match.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current_revision):
227	        return None
228	    reserve = num((match or {}).get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
229	    return stroke + 2 * reserve if reserve is not None else None

236	    """None if `m` contradicts the requirement or too little of it was read; else the attributes that could not be
237	    verified (not shown, or the usable-travel reserve unknown)."""
238	    if sum(not blank(m.get(a)) for a in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")) < min_known:
239	        return None
240	    unverified = []
241	    for attr, equal in (("bore", same), ("pressure", same), ("mounting", text_equal), ("certification", text_equal)):
242	        if blank(m.get(attr)):
243	            unverified.append(attr)
244	        elif not equal(m.get(attr), req.get(attr)):
245	            return None
246	    have = num(m.get("stroke"))
247	    if have is None:
248	        unverified.append("stroke")
249	    elif stroke is not None:
250	        if have != stroke:
251	            return None
252	    else:                                  # usable travel, reserve unknown: nominal stroke must at least cover it
253	        usable = num(req.get("stroke"))
254	        if usable is None or have < usable:
255	            return None
256	        unverified.append("stroke")
257	    return unverified

275	        for m in materials.values():
276	            if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:

279	            if unverified is None:
280	                continue
281	            active = m.get("is_active")
282	            cands.append({"material": m["material"], "status": m.get("status_code"), "unverified": unverified,
283	                          "stroke": m.get("stroke"),
284	                          "active": True if active in (True, "true") else False if active in (False, "false") else None})
285	        # best first: active before unknown status, fully verified before unverified, then the shortest fitting stroke
286	        usable = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is True and not c["unverified"]]
287	        usable.sort(key=lambda c: (c["active"] is not True, len(c["unverified"]),
288	                                   norm_ref(c["material"]) not in priced, num(c["stroke"]) or Decimal(0)))
289	        required = {k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe")}
290	        required["stroke"] = None if stroke is None else format(stroke.normalize(), "f")
291	        if usable:
292	            best = usable[0]
293	            reason = ("exact active match" if best["active"] and not best["unverified"] else
294	                      "exact match, status not read" if not best["unverified"] else
295	                      f"match, unverified: {', '.join(best['unverified'])}"
296	                      + ("" if best["active"] else ", status not read"))
297	            out[pos] = {"material": best["material"], "required": required, "candidates": cands, "reason": reason,
298	                        "unverified": best["unverified"] + ([] if best["active"] else ["status"])}
299	        else:
300	            out[pos] = {"material": None, "required": required, "candidates": cands, "unverified": [],
301	                        "reason": "only blocked matches" if cands and all(c["active"] is False and not c["unverified"] for c in cands) else "no verified active exact match among the ERP records read"}
302	    return out

305	def search_candidates(cache: dict, item: dict) -> list[str]:
306	    """Material numbers of the catalogue group `item` (a scraper work item) that fit one of its requirements on the
307	    pages read so far: the materials worth opening. Same tolerant check as the matcher (stroke may still differ by
308	    the reserve, so it only has to cover the usable travel / be unknown)."""
309	    group = norm_ref(item.get("group"))
310	    materials = merge_materials(list(cache.values()), [item.get("group")] if item.get("group") else [])
311	    out = []
312	    for m in materials.values():
313	        if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
314	            continue
315	        if group and not norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and "list" not in m.get("seen_in", []):
316	            continue
317	        for req in item.get("requirements") or []:
318	            loose = dict(req, stroke_kind="usable") if req.get("stroke_kind") == "usable" else req
319	            stroke = None if loose.get("stroke_kind") == "usable" else num(req.get("stroke"))
320	            if check(m, loose, stroke, min_known=0) is not None:      # unread attributes: open it and see
321	                out.append(m["material"])

1	"""Model access for agents: concurrency-limited, usage-counted, JSON-friendly. Qwen by default (hosted, free)."""
2	import asyncio
3	import json
4	import re
5	import os
6	import httpx
7	
8	CALL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "55"))
9	HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, connect=8, write=15, pool=8)
10	
11	import models
12	from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError
13	
14	
15	def parse_json(text: str):
16	    """The first JSON object/array in a model reply (tolerates ``` fences and chatter)."""
17	    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M).strip()
18	    for opener, closer in (("{", "}"), ("[", "]")):
19	        start, end = text.find(opener), text.rfind(closer)
20	        if start != -1 and end > start:
21	            try:
22	                return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
23	            except ValueError:
24	                continue
25	    raise ValueError(f"no JSON in model reply: {text[:200]}")
26	
27	
28	class LLM:
29	    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = 16):
30	        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)   # team limit is 32 concurrent Qwen calls
31	        self._analysis_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, max_concurrent // 2))
32	        self._client = None
33	        self.calls = 0
34	        self.tokens = {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}
35	
36	    @property
37	    def client(self):
38	        self._client = self._client or models.qwen().with_options(timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
39	        return self._client
40	
41	    async def chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, model: str = models.QWEN_MODEL,
42	                   think: bool = False, **kwargs):
43	        """One chat completion; returns the message (`.content`, `.tool_calls`). `think=True` lets Qwen run its
44	        separate reasoning pass (slower, more tokens): use it for judgement calls, not for plain extraction."""
45	        args = dict(model=model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
46	        args.setdefault("temperature", 0)
47	        if not think and model == models.QWEN_MODEL:
48	            args["extra_body"] = {**(args.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
49	        if tools:
50	            args["tools"] = tools
51	        async with self._analysis_sem, self._sem:
52	            # Bound each attempt, including providers that leave a connection open without replying.
53	            for attempt in range(2):
54	                try:
55	                    async with asyncio.timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S):
56	                        reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**args)
57	                    break
58	                except (TimeoutError, models.httpx.TransportError, APIConnectionError):
59	                    if attempt:
60	                        raise
61	                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
62	                except APIStatusError as error:
63	                    if attempt or (error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429):
64	                        raise
65	                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
66	        self.calls += 1
67	        if reply.usage:
68	            self.tokens["prompt"] += reply.usage.prompt_tokens or 0
69	            self.tokens["completion"] += reply.usage.completion_tokens or 0
70	        return reply.choices[0].message
71	
72	    async def ask(self, system: str, user: str, **kwargs) -> str:
73	        message = await self.chat([{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], **kwargs)
74	        return message.content or ""
75	
76	    async def ask_json(self, system: str, user: str, retries: int = 1, **kwargs):
77	        """Ask for JSON; re-ask once with the parse error if the reply is not valid."""
78	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
79	        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON
80	        for _ in range(retries + 1):
81	            reply = (await self.chat(messages, **kwargs)).content or ""
82	            try:
83	                return parse_json(reply)
84	            except ValueError as error:
85	                messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply},
86	                             {"role": "user", "content": f"Invalid: {error}. Reply with valid JSON only."}]
87	        raise ValueError("model did not return valid JSON")

1	"""Helpers for analysts: read the pages the scrapers saved and let the model turn them into structured JSON.
2	
3	The scrapers decide which pages matter (`read_page` with a topic -> Evidence kind "<role>.page"); analysts send that
4	text plus a JSON shape to the model and validate the reply in code. Long texts are split at page boundaries.
5	"""
6	import asyncio
7	import logging
8	import re
9	
10	log = logging.getLogger("extract")
11	
12	SYSTEM = ("Extract facts from German business web pages for bid calculation. Copy values exactly as shown (keep "
13	          "number strings with locale marker like '(en-US)', keep units). Never invent; value not on page -> null. "
14	          "Reply JSON only, in requested shape.")
15	CHUNK = 40_000
16	
17	
18	def pages(ctx, role: str) -> list:
19	    """Saved page evidence of a role ('tender', 'spec', 'erp', 'mail'), oldest first, exact duplicates dropped."""
20	    seen, out = set(), []
21	    for e in ctx.board.query(f"{role}.page"):
22	        key = (e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", "")))
23	        if key not in seen:
24	            seen.add(key)
25	            out.append(e)
26	    from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
27	    for e in ctx.board.query(role + ".", prefix=True):
28	        if not e.kind.endswith(".page") and e.data.get("_observed_text"):
29	            key = (e.source, hash(e.data["_observed_text"]))
30	            if key not in seen:
31	                seen.add(key)
32	                out.append(Evidence(role + ".page", e.site, {"topic": e.kind, "url": e.source,
33	                                  "text": e.data["_observed_text"]}, source=e.source, author=e.author))
34	    return out
35	
36	
37	def page_block(e) -> str:
38	    d = e.data
39	    return f"=== PAGE topic={d.get('topic')!r} url={d.get('url')} title={d.get('title')!r}\n{d.get('text', '')}"
40	
41	
42	def records(ctx, kind_prefix: str) -> list[dict]:
43	    """Facts the browsing model recorded directly with `record` (kind starting with the prefix)."""
44	    return [{"kind": e.kind, **(e.data or {}), "_source": e.source, "_note": e.note}
45	            for e in ctx.board.query(kind_prefix, prefix=True) if not e.kind.endswith(".page")]
46	
47	
48	PAGE_BREAK = "\n\n----- next page -----\n\n"
49	
50	
51	def chunks(blocks: list[str], size: int = CHUNK) -> list[str]:
52	    """Pack blocks into chunks of about `size` characters; a long block is split at its page breaks first (so a
53	    paged list is cut between pages, not inside an entry), and only then at `size`."""
54	    out, cur = [], ""
55	    for b in blocks:
56	        head = b.split("\n", 1)[0] + "\n" if b.startswith("=== PAGE") else ""
57	        parts = b.split(PAGE_BREAK)
58	        pieces = []
59	        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
60	            part = part if i == 0 else head + part
61	            pieces += [part[j:j + size] for j in range(0, len(part), size)] or [""]
62	        for piece in pieces:
63	            if cur and len(cur) + len(piece) > size:
64	                out.append(cur)
65	                cur = ""
66	            cur += piece + "\n\n"
67	    if cur.strip():
68	        out.append(cur)
69	    return out
70	
71	
72	async def extract(ctx, instruction: str, shape: str, blocks: list[str], *, list_key: str | tuple | None = None,
73	                  context: str = "", chunk_size: int = CHUNK) -> dict:
74	    """Ask the model to extract `shape` from the blocks. With `list_key` (one key or several), chunks are processed in
75	    parallel and the lists under those keys are concatenated (for long paged lists); otherwise one call."""
76	    keys = (list_key,) if isinstance(list_key, str) else tuple(list_key or ())
77	    if not blocks:
78	        return {k: [] for k in keys}
79	    user_head = f"{instruction}\n\nJSON shape:\n{shape}\n" + (f"\nContext:\n{context}\n" if context else "")
80	    if not keys:
81	        out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, user_head + "\nPAGES:\n" + "\n\n".join(blocks))
82	        return out if isinstance(out, dict) else {}
83	    parts = chunks(blocks, chunk_size)
84	    replies = await asyncio.gather(*(ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, user_head + "\nPAGES:\n" + p) for p in parts),
85	                                   return_exceptions=True)
86	    merged: dict = {k: [] for k in keys}
87	    for r in replies:
88	        if isinstance(r, Exception):
89	            merged["_incomplete"] = True
90	            log.warning("extract chunk failed: %s", type(r).__name__)
91	            continue
92	        if isinstance(r, list) and len(keys) == 1:
93	            merged[keys[0]] += r
94	        elif isinstance(r, dict):
95	            for k, v in r.items():
96	                if k in keys:
97	                    merged[k] += v if isinstance(v, list) else []
98	                elif v not in (None, "", [], {}):
99	                    merged.setdefault(k, v)
100	    return merged
101	
102	
103	def brief_section(brief: str, *names: str) -> str:
104	    """The text of markdown sections whose heading contains one of `names` (case-insensitive)."""
105	    out, keep = [], False
106	    for line in brief.splitlines():
107	        if line.startswith("#"):
108	            keep = any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in names)
109	        if keep:
110	            out.append(line)
111	    return "\n".join(out).strip()
112	
113	
114	def brief_intro(brief: str, limit: int = 1500) -> str:
115	    """The brief up to its first second-level section: who we are and what the tender is."""
116	    head = re.split(r"\n##\s", brief, maxsplit=1)[0]
117	    return head.strip()[:limit]

        kwargs.setdefault("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + 150)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)
        except Exception as error:
            self.log.warning("login browse failed: %s", error)

    def topic_jobs(self, facts: dict, covered: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})
        senders.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("director_sender") or "")
        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Find mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}' in inbox and "
                        f"archive; read every matching message.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\nThen done.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            from agents.analyze_discount import publish
            valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

90	    mail = {"condition_rules": {k: e.get("discount_scope") for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "condition_rules").items()},

92	                                  for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "technical_release").items()},
93	            "packaging_tariffs": {k: s(e.get("eur_per_carton")) for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "packaging_tariffs").items()},
94	            "delivery_commitments": {k: {"material": e.get("material"), "weeks": s(e.get("weeks")),

96	                                     for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "delivery_commitments").items()},
97	            "setup_pools": {k: s(e.get("pool_fee_eur")) for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "setup_pools").items()},
98	            "project_bonus": {k: [{"from": s(b.get("from_eur")) or "0", "to": s(b.get("to_eur")), "percent": s(b.get("percent"))}

100	                              for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "project_bonus").items()},

1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: spec.page (done.spec), results["tender"]   WRITES: results["spec"], results["requirements"]
2	"""Requirements of the specification revision marked current, with the tender Q&A's scoped amendments applied.
3	
4	results["spec"] = {"revisions": [{"revision", "date", "status", "is_current"}], "current": "R-..."}
5	results["requirements"] = {ref: {"bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind": "nominal"|"usable", "pressure", "mounting",
6	    "certification", "kataloggruppe", "pieces_per_set", "reserve_key", "revision", "amended": [..]}}
7	Numbers are plain strings without locale noise (e.g. "200"); stroke is the value after amendments (usable travel if
8	stroke_kind == "usable"; the matcher adds the end reserves from the technical release mail).
9	It is written up to three times: early, as soon as a requirement table page is saved (so the ERP search can start
10	while the spec scraper finishes), then from all spec pages, then with amendments, followed by
11	results["requirements_final"] = True.
12	"""
13	import asyncio
14	import logging
15	
16	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
17	from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
18	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal
19	
20	log = logging.getLogger("RequirementAnalyzer")
21	
22	SHAPE = """{"revisions": [{"revision": "", "date": "ISO date (mind the stated MM/DD or DD/MM order)", "status": "as shown",
23	               "is_current": true/false}],
24	 "requirements": [{"revision": "revision these values belong to", "ref": "requirement reference as shown",
25	   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
26	   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
27	   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
28	   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
29	   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
30	   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""
31	
32	NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")
33	
34	
35	def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
36	    value = to_decimal(text)
37	    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")
38	
39	
40	def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
41	    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
42	    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
43	              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
44	              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
45	    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
46	                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
47	    for c in amendments:
48	        a = c["amendment"]
49	        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
50	            continue
51	        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
52	        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
53	        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
54	            continue
55	        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
56	        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
57	    return requirements
58

60	async def analyse(ctx) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
61	    """Extract pages independently and publish every completed requirement table immediately."""
62	    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("spec.extracted", {})
63	    async with ctx.lock("spec.extract"):
64	        async def one(e):
65	            key = (e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", "")))
66	            if key in cache:
67	                return
68	            try:
69	                out = await extract(ctx, "Extract specification revision statuses and requirement rows. Mark current only with explicit valid/current status; never superseded.",
70	                                    SHAPE, [page_block(e)], list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
71	                if out.get("_incomplete"):
72	                    return
73	                cache[key] = out
74	                revisions, current, requirements = merge_spec(ctx)
75	                if current:
76	                    await ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions":revisions, "current":current})
77	                    ctx.shared["spec.base_requirements"] = requirements
78	                    await publish(ctx)
79	            except Exception as error:
80	                ctx.board.error("RequirementAnalyzer", f"spec extraction: {type(error).__name__}")
81	        await asyncio.gather(*(one(e) for e in pages(ctx, "spec")))
82	    return merge_spec(ctx)
83

85	def merge_spec(ctx) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
86	    cache = ctx.shared.get("spec.extracted", {})
87	    completed = [cache.get((e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", ""))), {}) for e in pages(ctx, "spec")]
88	    revisions = [r for page in completed for r in page.get("revisions") or []]
89	    flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
90	    flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
91	    current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
92	    rows = [r for page in completed for r in page.get("requirements") or []]
93	    rows = [r for r in rows if current and norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)]
94	    requirements = {}
95	    for r in rows:
96	        ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
97	        if not ref:
98	            continue
99	        entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
100	        entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
101	        entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
102	        entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
103	        entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
104	        merged = requirements.setdefault(ref, {})
105	        merged.update({k: v for k, v in entry.items() if v not in (None, "")})
106	    return revisions, current, requirements
107

109	async def refresh(ctx, wait_tender: float = 0) -> dict:
110	    """Analyse the saved spec pages, apply the tender's amendments; publishes spec, requirements,
111	    requirements_final. `wait_tender`: seconds to wait for the tender analysis (amendments come from its Q&A)."""
112	    if not pages(ctx, "spec"):
113	        raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
114	    revisions, current, requirements = await analyse(ctx)
115	    if requirements:
116	        ctx.shared["spec.base_requirements"] = requirements
117	    await ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
118	    if requirements:
119	        await ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
120	    log.info("current revision %s, requirements %s", current, list(requirements))
121	    tender = ctx.board.get("tender")
122	    if tender is None and wait_tender > 0:
123	        tender = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=wait_tender)
124	    return await publish(ctx)
125	
126	
127	async def publish(ctx) -> dict:
128	    """Reapply newly arrived Q&A to original revision facts, never to already amended values."""
129	    from copy import deepcopy
130	    base = ctx.shared.get("spec.base_requirements")
131	    if base is None:
132	        return ctx.board.get("requirements") or {}
133	    current = (ctx.board.get("spec") or {}).get("current", "")
134	    # A newer governing revision may have been observed before its requirements finish extracting.
135	    base = {k:v for k,v in base.items() if norm_ref(v.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)}
136	    amended = apply_amendments(deepcopy(base), current, (ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("clarifications") or [])
137	    await ctx.board.set("requirements", amended)
138	    if ctx.board.get("done.spec") is not None and ctx.board.get("tender_final"):
139	        await ctx.board.set("requirements_final", True)
140	    return amended
141

143	@register
144	class RequirementAnalyzer(Agent):
145	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
146	
147	    async def run(self) -> None:
148	        # Every newly saved spec page is a trigger. Topic spelling cannot delay ERP startup.
149	        seen = -1
150	        while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:
151	            count = len(pages(self.ctx, "spec"))
152	            if count and count != seen:
153	                try:
154	                    await refresh(self.ctx)
155	                    seen = count
156	                except Exception as error:
157	                    self.log.warning("spec extraction will retry: %s", type(error).__name__)
158	            if self.ctx.board.get("done.spec") is not None:
159	                if count and seen != count:

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: spec.page (done.spec), results["tender"]   WRITES: results["spec"], results["requirements"]
"""Requirements of the specification revision marked current, with the tender Q&A's scoped amendments applied.

results["spec"] = {"revisions": [{"revision", "date", "status", "is_current"}], "current": "R-..."}
results["requirements"] = {ref: {"bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind": "nominal"|"usable", "pressure", "mounting",
    "certification", "kataloggruppe", "pieces_per_set", "reserve_key", "revision", "amended": [..]}}
Numbers are plain strings without locale noise (e.g. "200"); stroke is the value after amendments (usable travel if
stroke_kind == "usable"; the matcher adds the end reserves from the technical release mail).
It is written up to three times: early, as soon as a requirement table page is saved (so the ERP search can start
while the spec scraper finishes), then from all spec pages, then with amendments, followed by
results["requirements_final"] = True.
"""
import asyncio
import logging

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal

log = logging.getLogger("RequirementAnalyzer")

SHAPE = """{"revisions": [{"revision": "", "date": "ISO date (mind the stated MM/DD or DD/MM order)", "status": "as shown",
               "is_current": true/false}],
 "requirements": [{"revision": "revision these values belong to", "ref": "requirement reference as shown",
   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""

NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")


def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
    value = to_decimal(text)
    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")


def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
    for c in amendments:
        a = c["amendment"]
        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
            continue
        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
            continue
        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
    return requirements


async def analyse(ctx) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
    """Extract pages independently and publish every completed requirement table immediately."""
    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("spec.extracted", {})
    async with ctx.lock("spec.extract"):
        async def one(e):
            key = (e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", "")))
            if key in cache:
                return
            try:
                out = await extract(ctx, "Extract specification revision statuses and requirement rows. Mark current only with explicit valid/current status; never superseded.",
                                    SHAPE, [page_block(e)], list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
                if out.get("_incomplete"):
                    return
                cache[key] = out
                revisions, current, requirements = merge_spec(ctx)
                if current:
                    await ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions":revisions, "current":current})
                    ctx.shared["spec.base_requirements"] = requirements
                    await publish(ctx)
            except Exception as error:
                ctx.board.error("RequirementAnalyzer", f"spec extraction: {type(error).__name__}")
        await asyncio.gather(*(one(e) for e in pages(ctx, "spec")))
    return merge_spec(ctx)


def merge_spec(ctx) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
    cache = ctx.shared.get("spec.extracted", {})
    completed = [cache.get((e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", ""))), {}) for e in pages(ctx, "spec")]
    revisions = [r for page in completed for r in page.get("revisions") or []]
    flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
    flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
    current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
    rows = [r for page in completed for r in page.get("requirements") or []]
    rows = [r for r in rows if current and norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)]
    requirements = {}
    for r in rows:
        ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
        if not ref:
            continue
        entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
        entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
        entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
        entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
        entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
        merged = requirements.setdefault(ref, {})
        merged.update({k: v for k, v in entry.items() if v not in (None, "")})
    return revisions, current, requirements


async def refresh(ctx, wait_tender: float = 0) -> dict:
    """Analyse the saved spec pages, apply the tender's amendments; publishes spec, requirements,
    requirements_final. `wait_tender`: seconds to wait for the tender analysis (amendments come from its Q&A)."""
    if not pages(ctx, "spec"):
        raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
    revisions, current, requirements = await analyse(ctx)
    if requirements:
        ctx.shared["spec.base_requirements"] = requirements
    await ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
    if requirements:
        await ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
    log.info("current revision %s, requirements %s", current, list(requirements))
    tender = ctx.board.get("tender")
    if tender is None and wait_tender > 0:
        tender = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=wait_tender)
    return await publish(ctx)


async def publish(ctx) -> dict:
    """Reapply newly arrived Q&A to original revision facts, never to already amended values."""
    from copy import deepcopy
    base = ctx.shared.get("spec.base_requirements")
    if base is None:
        return ctx.board.get("requirements") or {}
    current = (ctx.board.get("spec") or {}).get("current", "")
    # A newer governing revision may have been observed before its requirements finish extracting.
    base = {k:v for k,v in base.items() if norm_ref(v.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)}
    amended = apply_amendments(deepcopy(base), current, (ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("clarifications") or [])
    await ctx.board.set("requirements", amended)
    if ctx.board.get("done.spec") is not None and ctx.board.get("tender_final"):
        await ctx.board.set("requirements_final", True)
    return amended


@register
class RequirementAnalyzer(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        # Every newly saved spec page is a trigger. Topic spelling cannot delay ERP startup.
        seen = -1
        while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:
            count = len(pages(self.ctx, "spec"))
            if count and count != seen:
                try:
                    await refresh(self.ctx)
                    seen = count
                except Exception as error:
                    self.log.warning("spec extraction will retry: %s", type(error).__name__)
            if self.ctx.board.get("done.spec") is not None:
                if count and seen != count:
                    await refresh(self.ctx)
                # Tender amendments can arrive after the initial requirement table.
                try:
                    await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=max(1, self.ctx.time_left()))
                except TimeoutError:
                    return
                await refresh(self.ctx)
                return
            await asyncio.sleep(2)

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: tender.page (done.tender)   WRITES: results["tender"], results["quantities"]
"""Turns the saved tender pages into positions and Q&A records, then applies the quantity rules in code.

results["tender"] = {
  "meta": {"reference", "deadline", ...},
  "positions": [{"position", "short_text", "quantity" (as shown), "unit", "requirement_ref"}],
  "clarifications": [{"number", "date", "kind", "positions": [...], "new_quantity", "withdraws": [...],
                      "amendment": {...} | null, "keys": {...}, "setup_fee": str | null, "text"}]
}
results["quantities"] = {position: {"quantity": int (in the position's unit), "unit": str, "basis": str}}
Rule: tender quantity, overridden by the latest dated clarification that changes it; withdrawn answers are ignored.
"""
import asyncio
import logging

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_int

log = logging.getLogger("QuantityAnalyzer")

POSITIONS_SHAPE = """{"meta": {"reference": "", "title": "", "deadline": "", "timezone": ""},
 "positions": [{"position": "position number as shown", "short_text": "", "quantity": "as shown", "unit": "",
                "requirement_ref": "requirement reference as shown"}]}"""

QA_SHAPE = """{"clarifications": [{
  "number": "Q&A number", "date": "UTC ISO timestamp if shown, else as shown", "question": "", "answer": "full answer text",
  "kind": "quantity_change | withdrawal | technical_amendment | commercial_keys | setup_fee | other",
  "positions": ["position numbers this answer applies to"],
  "new_quantity": "new total quantity as shown, or null", "quantity_unit": "unit of that quantity or null",
  "withdraws": ["numbers of earlier answers this one EXPLICITLY withdraws/retracts (zurückgezogen); a newer value replacing an older one is not a withdrawal"],
  "amendment": {"document": "", "revision": "", "requirement": "", "attribute": "", "value": ""} or null,
  "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": null, "packaging_tariff": null, "delivery_key": null, "setup_pool": null, "bonus_plan": null},
  "setup_fee": "one-off setup cost amount as shown, or null"}]}"""


def withdrawn_numbers(clarifications: list[dict]) -> set[str]:
    """Numbers of answers explicitly withdrawn by a withdrawal answer (a newer value is not a withdrawal)."""
    return {norm_ref(n) for c in clarifications if c.get("kind") == "withdrawal" for n in (c.get("withdraws") or [])}


def final_quantities(positions: list[dict], clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
    out = {}
    for p in positions:
        pos = str(p.get("position") or "").strip()
        if not pos:
            continue
        qty, basis = to_int(p.get("quantity")), "tender"
        changes = [c for c in clarifications
                   if c.get("new_quantity") not in (None, "") and norm_ref(c.get("number")) not in withdrawn
                   and pos in [str(x).strip() for x in (c.get("positions") or [])]]
        changes.sort(key=lambda c: (to_datetime(c.get("date")) is not None, to_datetime(c.get("date")) or 0,
                                    to_int(c.get("number")) or 0))
        if changes:
            latest = changes[-1]
            qty, basis = to_int(latest.get("new_quantity")), f"Q&A {latest.get('number')}"
        out[pos] = {"quantity": qty, "unit": p.get("unit"), "basis": basis}
    return out


def _key(e):
    return (e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", "")))


async def publish(ctx) -> dict:
    """Reconcile completed page extractions in observation order, without another model call."""
    cache = ctx.shared.get("tender.extracted", {})
    meta, positions, clarifications = {}, {}, {}
    for e in pages(ctx, "tender"):
        for kind in ("positions", "clarifications"):
            result = cache.get((_key(e), kind), {})
            meta.update({k: v for k, v in (result.get("meta") or {}).items() if v})
            for row in result.get("positions") or []:
                pos = str(row.get("position") or "").strip()
                if pos:
                    positions.setdefault(pos, {}).update({k:v for k,v in row.items() if v not in (None, "")})
            for row in result.get("clarifications") or []:
                key = norm_ref(row.get("number")) or norm_ref(row.get("question"))
                if key:
                    clarifications[key] = row
    if not positions:
        return ctx.board.get("tender") or {}
    tender = {"meta":meta, "positions":list(positions.values()), "clarifications":list(clarifications.values())}
    await ctx.board.set("tender", tender)
    await ctx.board.set("quantities", final_quantities(tender["positions"], tender["clarifications"]))
    from agents import analyze_requirements
    await analyze_requirements.publish(ctx)
    return tender


async def refresh(ctx) -> dict:
    """Stream each completed extraction; a slow Q&A page cannot hide already known positions."""
    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("tender.extracted", {})
    ref = (ctx.board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference", "")
    async with ctx.lock("tender.extract"):
        async def one(e, kind, shape, instruction):
            key = (_key(e), kind)
            if key in cache:
                return
            try:
                result = await extract(ctx, instruction, shape, [page_block(e)], list_key=kind)
                if result.get("_incomplete"):
                    return
                cache[key] = result
                await publish(ctx)
            except Exception as error:
                ctx.board.error("QuantityAnalyzer", f"{kind} extraction: {type(error).__name__}")
        await asyncio.gather(*(one(e, kind, shape, instruction) for e in pages(ctx, "tender")
            for kind, shape, instruction in (
                ("positions", POSITIONS_SHAPE, "Extract original tender positions and metadata. Do not treat Q&A quantities as original quantities."),
                ("clarifications", QA_SHAPE, f"Extract every bidder Q&A for exact tender {ref}; ignore unrelated tenders."))))
    result = await publish(ctx)
    log.info("%d positions, %d Q&A", len(result.get("positions", [])), len(result.get("clarifications", [])))
    return result


@register
class QuantityAnalyzer(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        seen = -1
        while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:
            count = len(pages(self.ctx, "tender"))
            if count and count != seen:
                await refresh(self.ctx)
                seen = count
            if self.ctx.board.get("done.tender") is not None:
                await refresh(self.ctx)
                await self.ctx.board.set("tender_final", True)
                from agents import analyze_requirements
                await analyze_requirements.publish(self.ctx)
                return
            await asyncio.sleep(2)

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: tender portal (role "tender")
"""Reads the tender: overview, bill of quantities and ALL bidder Q&A, saved as page evidence ("tender.page").
Analysts turn the pages into positions, quantities, amendments and commercial keys (agents/analyze_quantities.py).

The main tab logs in and opens the tender; then the documents (main tab) and the Q&A (a second tab, sharing the
login) are read at the same time."""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

QA_JOB = ("Open this tender's bidder questions/answers (Q&A, Bieterfragen) and read_page them with topic 'bidder Q&A' "
          "and next_page_link = exact text of next-page link, so every page read in one action. Then done.")
DOCS_JOB = ("Open this tender's documents. read_page (topic naming the document) the document(s) listing positions "
            "with quantities, units, requirement references (bill of quantities / position overview). Documents locked "
            "-> register interest first. One read per document. Then done, listing what you saved.")


@register
class TenderScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "tender"
    browser = 0
    max_steps = 28
    hints = ("Adapt to the observed software; these are possible patterns, not requirements. Portal habits: cookie wall after login; error pages that go away on retry; survey popups and decoy "
             "'open'/'accept' links leading away (close popups with their x button); documents may need expression of "
             "interest first, may open in viewers/iframes or ZIP downloads (prefer viewer); Q&A list paged, answers in "
             "collapsed rows inside iframes; dates may be in other timezone.")

    def goal(self) -> str:
        return ("Collect tender data for the reference in context. Do NOT enter or submit a bid.\n"
                "1. Log in, accept necessary cookies, open the tender (search its reference if not listed).\n"
                "2. read_page tender overview with topic 'tender overview' (reference, buyer, deadline + timezone).\n"
                "3. Documents locked -> register interest now.\n"
                "4. If the submission link's URL is already visible, share_tip it. This is optional: do not open "
                "the wizard or spend extra steps finding the link. Finish immediately after saving the overview "
                "and obtaining document access so collection can start.")

    def required(self):
        return [(("q&a", "bieterfrage", "frage", "question"), QA_JOB),
                (("leistungsverzeichnis", "positions", "quantities", "bill"),
                 "Open this tender's documents and read_page the bill of quantities / position overview with topic "
                 "'bill of quantities'. Then done.")]

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            first = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal(), attempts=1, max_steps=8)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", first["summary"])
            # main tab: documents; new tab: Q&A (shares the login)
            await asyncio.gather(self.browse_until_done(DOCS_JOB, attempts=2, max_steps=20),
                                 self.browse_in_tabs([QA_JOB], max_steps=20))
            for keywords, job in self.required():
                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

@register
class SpecScraper(SiteScraper):

    def goal(self) -> str:

            "Collect buyer's technical specification (Lastenheft) for the tender in context.\n"
            "1. Log in, accept necessary cookies, find this tender's specification in documents (register paged -> "
            "read_page with next_page_link), get read access to binding version.\n"
            "2. read_page specification page ONCE with topic 'spec revisions': text includes revision history with "
            "every status (statuses behind buttons/tooltips appear as '(tooltip: ...)'; no need to click). Decide from "
            "it which revision is current/valid (not superseded).\n"
            "3. Right away open requirement table of THAT revision (its revision link, or viewer URL with that "
            "revision), read_page with topic 'spec requirements <revision>' and next_page_link = exact next-page link "
            "text, so all requirement rows saved. Most important step; no steps on other revisions.\n"
            "4. Requirement data sheets or set definitions (pieces per set) in separate documents -> read_page them too.\n"

1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: verifier   NEEDS: all results   WRITES: results["verification"] (and may correct results)
2	"""Cross-checks before computing: the tender reference (mandatory for eligibility), positions vs quantities vs
3	materials, and which inputs are missing. Plain code; it never drops positions, it only reports (and fixes the
4	reference when the brief's and the portal's agree after normalisation).
5	
6	results["verification"] = {"issues": [str], "reference": str}
7	"""
8	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
9	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, strip_invisible
10	
11	
12	@register
13	class EvidenceVerifier(Agent):
14	    phase = Phase.VERIFY
15	
16	    async def run(self) -> None:
17	        board, issues = self.ctx.board, []
18	        brief = dict(board.get("brief") or {})
19	        tender = board.get("tender") or {}
20	        portal_ref = strip_invisible((tender.get("meta") or {}).get("reference"))
21	        ref = strip_invisible(brief.get("tender_reference"))
22	        if not ref and portal_ref and norm_ref(portal_ref) in norm_ref(self.ctx.brief):
23	            ref = portal_ref
24	            issues.append("reference taken from the tender portal (it also occurs in the brief)")
25	        elif ref and portal_ref and norm_ref(ref) != norm_ref(portal_ref):
26	            issues.append(f"reference mismatch: brief {ref!r} vs portal {portal_ref!r}; keeping the brief's")
27	        if not ref:
28	            issues.append("NO TENDER REFERENCE: the bid would be ineligible")
29	        brief["tender_reference"] = ref
30	        await board.set("brief", brief)
31	        positions = [str(p.get("position")) for p in tender.get("positions") or []]
32	        quantities, materials = board.get("quantities") or {}, board.get("materials") or {}
33	        for pos in positions:
34	            if (quantities.get(pos) or {}).get("quantity") in (None, 0):
35	                issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity missing")
36	            if not (materials.get(pos) or {}).get("material"):
37	                issues.append(f"{pos}: material missing ({(materials.get(pos) or {}).get('reason', 'not analysed')})")
38	        for key in ("discount", "mail", "erp", "requirements"):
39	            if board.get(key) is None:
40	                issues.append(f"{key}: not available")
41	        await board.set("verification", {"issues": issues, "reference": ref})
42	        self.log.info("verification: %s", issues)

"""Which website plays which role. Site ids and names differ between datasets, so the model maps them from the brief
once per run; the result is cached on the board as results["sites"] = {role: siteId}."""
import logging

log = logging.getLogger("sites")

ROLES = {
    "tender": "public procurement / tender portal: the tender, its bill of quantities, bidder Q&A, bid submission",
    "spec": "the buyer's supplier/customer portal holding the technical specification (Lastenheft) and its revisions",
    "erp": "our own ERP: materials, stock, lead times, price conditions",
    "mail": "our webmail / sales inbox: approvals, internal release mails, signing TANs",
}


async def resolve_roles(ctx) -> dict:
    """Map capabilities at runtime; incomplete mappings are retried, observed contradictions can be corrected."""
    async with ctx.lock("sites"):
        invalid = ctx.shared.setdefault("site_invalidations", {})
        known = {r: v for r, v in (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).items() if v not in invalid.get(r, set())}
        if all(role in known for role in ROLES):
            return known
        sites = [{"siteId": s.get("siteId"), "url": s.get("url")} for s in ctx.task.get("access", [])]
        mapping = dict(known)
        observations = ctx.shared.setdefault("site_observations", {})
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(
                    "Map roles to siteId using the brief and observations. Reply {tender: siteId, spec: siteId, "
                    "erp: siteId, mail: siteId, inspect: [siteId]}. Omit uncertain mappings and select up to two "
                    "sites to inspect when names are opaque. Multiple capabilities may share a site.",
                    f"Roles: {ROLES}\nSites: {sites}\nCurrent mapping: {mapping}\nObservations: {observations}\nRejected role/site pairs: {invalid}\nBrief:\n{ctx.brief}")
                mapping.update({r: v for r, v in (out or {}).items() if r in ROLES and v in ctx.site_ids and v not in invalid.get(r, set())})
                await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
                if all(role in mapping for role in ROLES):
                    break
                inspect = [v for v in (out or {}).get("inspect", []) if v in ctx.site_ids and v not in observations][:2]
                if inspect and getattr(ctx, "pool", None):
                    from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
                    for site_id in inspect:
                        site = ctx.site(site_id)
                        tab = Tab(ctx.site_ids.index(site_id) % 4)
                        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
                        try:
                            result = await browse(ctx, f"Inspect this workspace to identify its business capabilities: {site['url']}. "
                                                  f"Login if necessary using {creds}. Read its headings and menus. "
                                                  "Report what information it holds; do not submit anything.",
                                                  tab=tab, site_id=site_id, max_steps=5, author="SiteOrientation")
                            observations[site_id] = result["summary"][:2500]
                        finally:
                            await tab.close()
            except Exception as error:
                log.warning("role mapping attempt failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
        await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
        log.info("site roles: %s", mapping)
        return mapping


async def site_for(ctx, role: str) -> str:
    known = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get(role)
    if known in ctx.site_ids and known not in ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(role, set()):
        return known
    mapping = await resolve_roles(ctx)
    if role not in mapping:
        raise KeyError(f"no website found for role {role!r}: {mapping}")
    return mapping[role]

2	"""Reads the brief once at the start so every agent knows the tender reference, scenario date and bidder data.
3	
4	results["brief"] = {
5	  "tender_reference": str, "tender_title": str, "buyer": str, "scenario_date": ISO str, "deadline": str,
6	  "bidder_company": str, "bidder_vat_id": str, "director_sender": str (sender local part),
7	  "currency": str, "authorized_senders": {topic: local part}, "mail_topics": [word], "topic_words": {topic: word}
8	}
9	The reference is only accepted if it literally occurs in the brief (no model invention).
10	"""
11	import asyncio
12	import re
13	
14	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
15	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime
16	from swarm.sites import resolve_roles
17	
18	SHAPE = """{"tender_reference": "", "tender_title": "", "buyer": "", "scenario_date": "ISO 8601 with timezone",
19	"deadline": "", "bidder_company": "", "bidder_vat_id": "", "currency": "",
20	"director_sender": "local part of the sender who approves discounts, e.g. 'name@'",
21	"discount_topic": "German word for the discount approval topic",
22	"authorized_senders": {"<one of: discount_approval, condition_rules, technical_release, packaging_tariffs,
23	  delivery_commitments, setup_pools, project_bonus, fx_fixing, price_indices>": "<sender local part the brief names for it>"},
24	"mail_topics": ["every mail subject/topic word the brief says carries release data (e.g. condition rules, price indices)"],
25	"topic_words": {"<topic key as in authorized_senders>": "the word the brief uses for that topic (mail search term)"}}"""
26	
27	
28	def mask_secrets(brief: str, task: dict) -> str:
29	    """The brief with every login value replaced by a placeholder: logins never reach a model prompt.
30	    (From test_brief_reader's swarm/brief.py.)"""
31	    for site in task.get("access") or []:
32	        for key, value in (site.get("credentials") or {}).items():
33	            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) >= 4:
34	                brief = brief.replace(value, f"<{key}>")
35	    return brief
36	
37	
38	def checked(facts: dict, brief: str) -> dict:
39	    """Keep only values the brief actually contains (guards against invented values; from test_brief_reader):
40	    bidder data verbatim, sender local parts as written in the brief ('name@' or '/name')."""
41	    flat = " ".join(str(brief or "").split())
42	    facts = {k: (" ".join(v.split()) if isinstance(v, str) else v) for k, v in facts.items()}
43	    for name in ("bidder_company", "bidder_vat_id"):
44	        if facts.get(name) and facts[name] not in flat:
45	            facts[name] = ""
46	    senders = facts.get("authorized_senders") if isinstance(facts.get("authorized_senders"), dict) else {}
47	    facts["authorized_senders"] = {topic: local for topic, local in senders.items()
48	                                   if isinstance(local, str) and local.strip("@ ")
49	                                   and re.search(rf"(?<![\w.]){re.escape(local.strip('@ '))}(@|\b)", flat)}
50	    director = str(facts.get("director_sender") or "").strip("@ ")
51	    if director and not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.]){re.escape(director)}@", flat):
52	        facts["director_sender"] = ""
53	    return facts
54	
55	
56	@register
57	class BriefReader(Agent):
58	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
59	
60	    async def run(self) -> None:
61	        facts = await self.ctx.llm.ask_json(
62	            "Extract key facts from task brief. Copy values exactly. Reply JSON only.",
63	            f"Shape:\n{SHAPE}\n\nBRIEF:\n{mask_secrets(self.ctx.brief, self.ctx.task)}")
64	        facts = checked(facts or {}, self.ctx.brief)
65	        if norm_ref(facts.get("tender_reference")) not in norm_ref(self.ctx.brief):
66	            self.log.warning("reference %r not in brief; dropped", facts.get("tender_reference"))
67	            facts["tender_reference"] = ""
68	        if facts.get("scenario_date") and not to_datetime(facts["scenario_date"]):
69	            facts["scenario_date"] = ""
70	        await self.ctx.board.set("brief", facts)
71	        self.log.info("brief facts: %s", facts)
72	        await resolve_roles(self.ctx)

2	.SYNOPSIS
3	  Save a run's full log locally as Markdown, so it can be read and searched without waiting for the platform.
4	
5	  Writes .swarm/runs/<run>-log.md (whole log, replaced on every pull) and adds a line to .swarm/runs/<run>.md (notes:
6	  status, scores and MCP results go there). .swarm/ is git-ignored and never packaged: run logs hold scenario
7	  values, which must never get into the package.
8	
9	.EXAMPLE
10	  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc            # once (run ended or a snapshot)
11	  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc -Follow    # keep writing until the run ends
12	
13	  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
14	  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pull-run.ps1 <run> -Follow
15	#>

17	    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$RunId,
18	    [switch]$Follow
19	)

21	Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
22	$dir = ".swarm/runs"
23	New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
24	$notes = "$dir/$RunId.md"
25	$logFile = "$dir/$RunId-log.md"

27	
28	# cmd merges stderr (atira writes progress there) without PowerShell 5.1 turning each line into an error record
29	$status = (cmd /c "atira status 2>&1" | Select-String -SimpleMatch $RunId | Select-Object -First 1)
30	$status = if ($status) { $status.Line.Trim() } else { "(not in atira status)" }

33	    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "# $RunId`n`nFull log: [$RunId-log.md]($RunId-log.md). Notes and MCP pulls below, newest last.`n"
34	}
