<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Save a run's full log locally as Markdown, so it can be read and searched without waiting for the platform.

  Writes .swarm/runs/<run>-log.md (whole log, replaced on every pull) and adds a line to .swarm/runs/<run>.md (notes:
  status, scores and MCP results go there). .swarm/ is git-ignored and never packaged: run logs hold scenario
  values, which must never get into the package.

.EXAMPLE
  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc            # once (run ended or a snapshot)
  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc -Follow    # keep writing until the run ends

  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pull-run.ps1 <run> -Follow
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$RunId,
    [switch]$Follow
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
$dir = ".swarm/runs"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
$notes = "$dir/$RunId.md"
$logFile = "$dir/$RunId-log.md"
$now = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 'UTC'")

# cmd merges stderr (atira writes progress there) without PowerShell 5.1 turning each line into an error record
$status = (cmd /c "atira status 2>&1" | Select-String -SimpleMatch $RunId | Select-Object -First 1)
$status = if ($status) { $status.Line.Trim() } else { "(not in atira status)" }

if (-not (Test-Path $notes)) {
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "# $RunId`n`nFull log: [$RunId-log.md]($RunId-log.md). Notes and MCP pulls below, newest last.`n"
}
Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "`n## $now - log pulled`n`nStatus: $status`n"

# The platform keeps only the tail of a long log: a later pull can hold FEWER early lines than an earlier one. So the
# file is never replaced: lines it does not have yet are appended (in the order the platform returns them).
$known = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
if (Test-Path $logFile) {
    Get-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile | Where-Object { $_ -ne '```' } | ForEach-Object { [void]$known.Add($_) }
    $kept = Get-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile | Where-Object { $_ -ne '```' }
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile $kept
} else {
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile ("# $RunId log`n`nLines from every pull, merged (the platform keeps only the tail " +
                                         "of a long log, so early lines exist only in earlier pulls).`n`n" + '```text')
}
Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile "--- pull $now ($status) ---"
$add = { param($line) if ($known.Add($line)) { Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile $line } }
if ($Follow) {
    cmd /c "atira logs $RunId --follow 2>&1" | ForEach-Object { & $add $_; $_ }
} else {
    cmd /c "atira logs $RunId 2>&1" | ForEach-Object { & $add $_ }
}
Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile '```'
$lines = (Get-Content $logFile | Measure-Object -Line).Lines
Write-Host "saved $logFile ($lines lines) and $notes"

"""close_hung_tabs against a real Chromium: a tab blocked by a request that never answers is closed, a working tab is
kept (sandbox: one hung tab made every browser-use connect to that browser time out)."""
import asyncio
import http.server
import json
import socket
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.request
from unittest import mock

from swarm import browser_agent as ba


class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/hang"):
            threading.Event().wait(120)      # never answers
            return
        body = (b"<html><body>ok<script>if (location.search === '?block') { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); "
                b"x.open('GET', '/hang', false); x.send(); }</script></body></html>")
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)


def free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


class HungTabs(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_hung_tab_is_closed_and_working_tab_kept(self):
        from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

        server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        base, port = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}", free_port()

        async def run():
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=[f"--remote-debugging-port={port}"])
                context = await browser.new_context()
                good, bad = await context.new_page(), await context.new_page()
                await good.goto(base + "/")
                await bad.goto(base + "/")
                await bad.evaluate(f"setTimeout(() => location.href = '{base}/?block', 10)")
                await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
                with mock.patch.object(ba.browsers, "cdp_urls", return_value=[f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"]), \
                        mock.patch.object(ba, "TAB_PROBE_S", 3):
                    closed = await ba.close_hung_tabs(0)
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                listed = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json/list", timeout=5))
                urls = sorted(t["url"] for t in listed if t["type"] == "page" and t["url"].startswith(base))
                await browser.close()
                return closed, urls

        closed, urls = asyncio.run(run())
        server.shutdown()
        self.assertEqual(len(closed), 1)
        self.assertEqual(urls, [base + "/"])             # the working tab is still there, the hung one gone


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Browsers for agents. In a run: CDP browsers 1-4 from the sandbox (never launch your own). Locally: one Chromium."""
import browsers
import os
import json
import socket


class BrowserPool:
    def __init__(self, REDACTED):
        self._pw = REDACTED
        self._contexts: dict[int, object] = {}   # slot -> browser context
        self._local = []

    async def prepare(self):
        """Give local runs the same persistent CDP/tab lifecycle as sandbox runs."""
        if self._pw is None or browsers.cdp_urls():
            return
        urls = []
        for _ in range(4):
            with socket.socket() as sock:
                sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
                port = sock.getsockname()[1]
            browser = await self._pw.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1",
                                                    args=[f"--remote-debugging-port={port}"])
            self._local.append(browser)
            urls.append(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
        os.environ["CDP_URLS"] = json.dumps(urls)

    async def close(self):
        if self._local:
            for browser in self._local:
                await browser.close()
            os.environ.pop("CDP_URLS", None)
            self._local.clear()

    async def context(self, index: int = 0):
        n = len(browsers.cdp_urls())
        slot = index % n if n else 0             # locally everything shares one Chromium
        if slot not in self._contexts:
            _, page = await browsers.connect(self._pw, slot)
            self._contexts[slot] = page.context
        return self._contexts[slot]

    async def new_page(self, index: int = 0):
        """A fresh tab in browser `index`; tabs are unlimited, browsers are not (max 4)."""
        return await (await self.context(index)).new_page()

"""The swarm framework against fakes: blackboard, JSON parsing, phase orchestration, failure isolation."""
import asyncio
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from swarm import Agent, Blackboard, Evidence, Phase  # noqa: E402
from swarm import orchestrator  # noqa: E402
from swarm.llm import parse_json  # noqa: E402

TASK = {"brief": "b", "access": [{"siteId": "erp", "url": "http://x", "credentials": {}}],
        "submission": {"kind": "api"}, "expires_at": None}


class BoardTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_post_query_and_wait(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        waiter = asyncio.create_task(board.wait_for(kind="a.b", timeout=2))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        await board.post(Evidence("a.b", "erp", {"x": 1}, source="u"))
        self.assertEqual((await waiter)[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(len(board.query("a", prefix=True)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(board.query("a.b", site="mail"), [])

    async def test_dump_and_load_round_trip(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {"x": 1}))
        await board.set("r", [1])
        path = Path(__file__).parent / "_board.json"
        try:
            board.dump(path)
            again = Blackboard.load(path)
        finally:
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.assertEqual(again.evidence[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(again.get("r"), [1])


class ParseJson(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fenced_and_chatty(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_json('Sure!\n```json\n{"a": [1, 2]}\n```'), {"a": [1, 2]})

    def test_garbage_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_json("no json here")


def make_agents(order):
    class Boom(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self): raise RuntimeError("boom")

    class Collect(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("collect")
            await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {}))

    class Analyze(Agent):
        phase = Phase.ANALYZE
        async def run(self):
            order.append(f"analyze sees {len(self.ctx.board.query('k'))}")

    class Submit(Agent):
        phase = Phase.SUBMIT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("submit")
            await self.ctx.board.set("answer", {"ok": True})

    return [Submit, Analyze, Boom, Collect]


class Orchestration(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def run_with(self, classes, task=TASK, env=None):
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "discover", lambda: classes):
            return await orchestrator.run_swarm(task, None, scored=True, env=env or {})

233	    `evaluate(js, *args)` runs a JS arrow function in the agent's current page."""
234	
235	    def __init__(self, ctx, author: str, careful: bool = False, fill=None):
236	        """`fill(pairs, then_click, item_id)` sets fields inside the observed gate only."""
237	        self.ctx, self.author, self.careful = ctx, author, careful
238	        self._fill = fill
239	        self._fresh: dict = {}             # decisions that are not cached (fills copying a code): used once
240	        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
241	        self._tries: dict[str, int] = {}
242	        self.actions = 0
243	
244	    async def fill(self, evaluate, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], then_click: str, item_id: int) -> str:
245	        if self._fill is not None:
246	            return await self._fill(pairs, then_click, item_id)
247	        from swarm.forms import fill_fields, scoped_evaluator
248	        return await fill_fields(scoped_evaluator(evaluate, item_id), pairs, "", then_click)
249	
250	    def _decide(self, site: str, items: list[dict]) -> dict[int, dict]:
251	        """Decisions for the scanned items that are known now (cached, or just classified for this guard). Unknown
252	        items are sent to the model in the background (one call per new item kind across all agents) and handled by
253	        a later sweep: a sweep never waits for the model, so the agent's step is never held up by it."""
254	        out, unknown = {}, []
255	        for item in items:
256	            key = (site, signature(item))
257	            if key in _DECISIONS:
258	                out[item["id"]] = _DECISIONS[key]
259	            elif key in self._fresh:
260	                observed, decision = self._fresh.pop(key)
261	                if observed == item.get("text"):
262	                    out[item["id"]] = decision
263	            elif key not in _PENDING:
264	                unknown.append((key, item))
265	        if unknown:
266	            for key, _ in unknown:
267	                _PENDING[key] = True
268	            task = asyncio.create_task(self._classify(site, unknown))
269	            _TASKS.add(task)                    # finishes even after this browse ended: other agents use the answer
270	            task.add_done_callback(_TASKS.discard)
271	        return out
272	
273	    async def _classify(self, site: str, unknown: list[tuple]) -> None:
274	        try:
275	            shown = [{k: item[k] for k in ("id", "kind", "text", "buttons", "fields")} for _, item in unknown]
276	            reply = await asyncio.wait_for(
277	                self.ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, json.dumps({"items": shown}, ensure_ascii=False)), CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_S)
278	            by_id = {d.get("id"): d for d in (reply or {}).get("items") or [] if isinstance(d, dict)}
279	            for key, item in unknown:
280	                decision = by_id.get(item["id"]) or {"action": "leave", "kind": "other"}
281	                if decision.get("action") != "fill" or cacheable_fill(decision):
282	                    _DECISIONS[key] = decision      # a fill that copies a displayed code: asked again each time
283	                else:
284	                    self._fresh[key] = (item.get("text"), decision)
285	                log.info("guard %s: %s %s -> %s %s", site, item["kind"], item["text"][:80], decision.get("action"),
286	                         decision.get("kind"))
287	        except Exception as error:              # model slow or failing: the agent handles these items itself
288	            log.debug("guard classification failed: %s", error)
289	        finally:
290	            for key, _ in unknown:
291	                _PENDING.pop(key, None)
292	
293	
294	    async def sweep(self, evaluate) -> int:
295	        """Clear the current page once; returns how many items were handled."""
296	        if self._lock.locked():                 # a sweep is running: wait for it instead of starting another
297	            async with self._lock:
298	                return 0
299	        async with self._lock:
300	            try:
301	                scan = await asyncio.wait_for(evaluate(SCAN_JS), EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
302	            except Exception:                   # page navigating / closed / frozen by a native dialog
303	                return 0
304	            items = (scan or {}).get("items") or [] if isinstance(scan, dict) else []
305	            if not items:
306	                return 0
307	            site = host(scan.get("url", ""))
308	            decisions = self._decide(site, items)
309	            handled = 0
310	            for item in items:
311	                decision = decisions.get(item["id"]) or {}
312	                sig = str(scan.get("url", "")) + "|" + signature(item)
313	                if decision.get("action") == "fill" and not cacheable_fill(decision):
314	                    sig += "|" + str(item.get("text", ""))
315	                if not allowed(decision, item, self.careful) or self._tries.get(sig, 0) >= MAX_ACTIONS_PER_ITEM:
316	                    continue
317	                self._tries[sig] = self._tries.get(sig, 0) + 1
318	                try:
319	                    if decision["action"] == "click":
320	                        button = pick_button(decision, item)
321	                        result = await asyncio.wait_for(evaluate(CLICK_JS, {"id": item["id"], "button": button,
322	                                                                          "allow_navigation": decision.get("kind") == "error"}),
323	                                                        EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
324	                        label = item["buttons"][button]["label"]
325	                    else:
326	                        pairs = [(str(f.get("field", "")), str(f.get("value", ""))) for f in decision.get("fields") or []
327	                                 if isinstance(f, dict)]
328	                        then_click = safe_then_click(decision, item)
329	                        result = await asyncio.wait_for(self.fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item["id"]),
330	                                                        3 * EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
331	                        label = then_click or "fields"
332	                except Exception as error:      # the item went away meanwhile
333	                    log.debug("guard action failed: %s", error)
334	                    continue
335	                handled += 1
336	                self.actions += 1
337	                log.info("guard %s [%s]: %s '%s' on %s: %s", site, self.author, decision["action"], label,
338	                         decision.get("kind"), str(result)[:120].replace("\n", "; "))
339	                await asyncio.sleep(0.6)        # let the page react before the agent reads it
340	            return handled
341	
342	    async def loop(self, evaluate, interval: float = GUARD_INTERVAL_S) -> None:
343	        while True:
344	            await asyncio.sleep(interval)
345	            try:
346	                await self.sweep(evaluate)
347	            except asyncio.CancelledError:
348	                raise
349	            except Exception as error:
350	                log.debug("guard sweep failed: %s", error)

"""Agent base class and registry. One agent = one file in `agents/`, registered with @register."""
import enum
import logging
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class Phase(enum.IntEnum):
    COLLECT = 1   # scrapers: read the sites, post Evidence
    ANALYZE = 2   # analyzers: turn evidence into structured facts (quantities, requirements, candidate materials...)
    VERIFY = 3    # verifiers: cross-check authority / dates / tender reference / superseded records
    COMPUTE = 4   # calculators: deterministic arithmetic, set results["bid"]
    SUBMIT = 5    # fills the configurator, signs; ALWAYS runs, with reserved time


REGISTRY: list[type["Agent"]] = []


def register(cls):
    REGISTRY.append(cls)
    return cls


class Agent(ABC):
    name: str = ""               # defaults to the class name
    phase: Phase = Phase.COLLECT
    browser: int | None = None   # index of the browser this agent drives (0-3), None = no browser

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.name = self.name or type(self).__name__
        self.log = logging.getLogger(self.name)

    @abstractmethod
    async def run(self) -> None:
        """Read from `self.ctx.board`, do the work, write Evidence / results back. Raise on failure (it is logged;
        other agents carry on). Stop early when `self.ctx.time_left() <= 0`."""

23	
24	    A locale given in the text, e.g. '(en-US)' or 'Zahlenformat: en-US', wins over `locale`. Without any hint a single
25	    separator followed by exactly three digits is ambiguous; it is read as a thousands separator only when the other
26	    separator style is impossible (e.g. '1.234' -> 1234 for de-DE hints, else 1.234).
27	    """
28	    if text is None or isinstance(text, bool):
29	        return None
30	    if isinstance(text, (int, float, Decimal)):
31	        return Decimal(str(text)) if Decimal(str(text)).is_finite() else None

34	    loc = (hint.group(1) if hint else (locale or "")).lower()

36	    if not m:
37	        return None

39	    if loc.startswith("de"):
40	        num = num.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
41	    elif loc.startswith("en"):
42	        num = num.replace(",", "")
43	    elif "," in num and "." in num:
44	        num = num.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".") if num.rfind(",") > num.rfind(".") else num.replace(",", "")

46	        num = num.replace(",", ".") if num.count(",") == 1 else num.replace(",", "")
47	    elif num.count(".") > 1:
48	        num = num.replace(".", "")

50	        result = Decimal(num)

52	    except InvalidOperation:
53	        return None

"""Model access for agents: concurrency-limited, usage-counted, JSON-friendly. Qwen by default (hosted, free)."""
import asyncio
import json
import re
import os
import httpx

CALL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "55"))
HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, connect=8, write=15, pool=8)

import models
from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError
from swarm import timeline

# Model slots (team limit: 32 concurrent Qwen calls). Browsing steps take a slot of the total; analysis, planning and
# guard calls also take one of the analysis slots, so extraction can never starve the browsing agents.
MAX_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_LLM_CONCURRENCY", "16"))
ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ANALYSIS_CONCURRENCY", "0")) or max(1, MAX_CONCURRENT // 2)


def parse_json(text: str):
    """The first JSON object/array in a model reply (tolerates ``` fences and chatter)."""
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M).strip()
    for opener, closer in (("{", "}"), ("[", "]")):
        start, end = text.find(opener), text.rfind(closer)
        if start != -1 and end > start:
            try:
                return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
            except ValueError:
                continue
    raise ValueError(f"no JSON in model reply: {text[:200]}")


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = MAX_CONCURRENT, analysis_concurrent: int | None = None):
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)   # team limit is 32 concurrent Qwen calls
        self._analysis_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(analysis_concurrent or
                                               (ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT if max_concurrent == MAX_CONCURRENT
                                                else max(1, max_concurrent // 2)))
        self._client = None
        self.calls = 0
        self.tokens = {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}

    @property
    def client(self):
        self._client = self._client or models.qwen().with_options(timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
        return self._client

    async def chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, model: str = models.QWEN_MODEL,
                   think: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """One chat completion; returns the message (`.content`, `.tool_calls`). `think=True` lets Qwen run its
        separate reasoning pass (slower, more tokens): use it for judgement calls, not for plain extraction."""
        args = dict(model=model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
        args.setdefault("temperature", 0)
        if not think and model == models.QWEN_MODEL:
            args["extra_body"] = {**(args.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
        if tools:
            args["tools"] = tools
        async with self._analysis_sem, self._sem:
            # Bound each attempt, including providers that leave a connection open without replying.
            for attempt in range(2):
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S):
                        reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**args)
                    break
                except (TimeoutError, models.httpx.TransportError, APIConnectionError):
                    if attempt:
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                except APIStatusError as error:
                    if attempt or (error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429):
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        self.calls += 1
        if reply.usage:
            self.tokens["prompt"] += reply.usage.prompt_tokens or 0
            self.tokens["completion"] += reply.usage.completion_tokens or 0
        return reply.choices[0].message

    async def ask(self, system: str, user: str, **kwargs) -> str:
        message = await self.chat([{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], **kwargs)
        return message.content or ""

    async def ask_json(self, system: str, user: str, retries: int = 1, **kwargs):
        """Ask for JSON; re-ask once with the parse error if the reply is not valid."""
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON
        for _ in range(retries + 1):
            reply = (await self.chat(messages, **kwargs)).content or ""
            try:
                return parse_json(reply)
            except ValueError as error:
                messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply},
                             {"role": "user", "content": f"Invalid: {error}. Reply with valid JSON only."}]
        raise ValueError("model did not return valid JSON")

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: COLLECT/ANALYZE are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0); VERIFY and COMPUTE (plain code,
instant) and SUBMIT always run.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: COLLECT/ANALYZE are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0); VERIFY and COMPUTE (plain code,
instant) and SUBMIT always run.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")
TIMELINE_DUMP = Path(".swarm/timeline.json")
PROGRESS_EVERY_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_PROGRESS_S", "60"))


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


# Plain-code phases (cross-checks, the bid arithmetic) take well under a second: they run even when collecting used up
# its time, otherwise the submitter would get no bid at all (it then omits every position).
ALWAYS = (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE, Phase.SUBMIT)
QUICK_BUDGET_S = 30


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    timeline.AGENT.set(agent.name)          # every span this agent (and the tasks it starts) records carries its name
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        if agent.phase in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            budget = max(budget, QUICK_BUDGET_S)
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


def _position_keys(tender: dict) -> dict:
    try:
        from agents.compute_bid import position_keys
        return {str(p.get("position")): position_keys(tender.get("clarifications") or [], str(p.get("position")))["keys"]
                for p in tender.get("positions") or []}
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a summary must never fail a run
        return {"error": str(error)[:80]}


def board_summary(board: Blackboard) -> dict:
    """A compact view of what the swarm knows (one log line), so a run's log shows it even if early lines are lost."""
    r = board.results
    erp = r.get("erp") or {}
    return {"pages": {k: sum(1 for e in board.evidence if e.kind == f"{k}.page") for k in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail")},
            "positions": len((r.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []),
            "qa": len((r.get("tender") or {}).get("clarifications") or []),
            "requirements": sorted(r.get("requirements") or {}),
            "materials": {p: (m.get("material"), m.get("reason")) for p, m in (r.get("materials") or {}).items()},
            "erp": {"materials": len(erp.get("materials") or {}), "conditions": len(erp.get("conditions") or []),
                    "stock": sorted(erp.get("stock") or {})},
            "discount": r.get("discount"),
            # which release mails were resolved, and which keys the Q&A gave each position: the two sides that must
            # meet for packaging, commitments, setup pools, project bonus and condition groups
            "mail_topics": {t: sorted(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v for t, v in (r.get("mail") or {}).items()},
            "position_keys": _position_keys(r.get("tender") or {}),
            "open_gaps": [g.get("id") for g in r.get("gaps") or []],
            "unresolved": (r.get("bid_draft") or {}).get("unresolved"),
            "tips": sum(len(v) for v in (r.get("tips") or {}).values()), "errors": len(board.errors)}


def progress_line(ctx) -> str:
    """One line per minute: clock, coverage of the draft bid, and where the last minute went."""
    tl = timeline.current()
    since = max(0.0, tl.now() - PROGRESS_EVERY_S)
    totals = tl.totals(since)
    cov = (ctx.board.get("bid_draft") or {}).get("coverage") or {}
    pages = "/".join(str(sum(1 for e in ctx.board.evidence if e.kind == f"{k}.page")) for k in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail"))

    def t(cat):
        x = totals.get(cat) or {"s": 0, "n": 0}
        return f"{x['s']:.0f}s/{x['n']}"
    return (f"progress {timeline.clock(tl.now())} left {ctx.seconds_left():.0f}s (collect {ctx.time_left():.0f}s, "
            f"reserve {ctx.submit_reserve():.0f}s) pages t/s/e/m {pages} positions {cov.get('priced', 0)}/"
            f"{cov.get('positions', 0)} priced, {cov.get('complete', 0)} complete, {cov.get('unresolved', 0)} open deps"
            f" | last {PROGRESS_EVERY_S:.0f}s: steps {t('browse.step')} queue {t('model.queue')} calls "
            f"{t('model.call')} extract {t('extract')} waits {t('wait.dep')} recovery {t('recovery')} | "
            f"model calls {ctx.llm.calls}")


async def _progress(ctx) -> None:
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(PROGRESS_EVERY_S)
        try:
            log.info(progress_line(ctx))
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - reporting must never fail a run
            log.debug("progress line failed: %s", error)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    tl = timeline.reset(ctx.monotonic_start)
    classes = select(discover(), None if scored else env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    from swarm.browser_agent import _MAIN_TABS, _OWNERS, _OPENERS
    from swarm import guard
    _MAIN_TABS.clear()
    _OWNERS.clear()
    _OPENERS.clear()
    guard._DECISIONS.clear()
    guard._PENDING.clear()
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    try:
        await ctx.pool.prepare()
        for phase in Phase:
            agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
            if not agents:
                continue
            bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
            if phase not in ALWAYS and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
                log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
                continue
            log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
            if phase == Phase.SUBMIT:
                timeline.mark("submit start", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()),
                              positions=len(((board.get("bid") or {}).get("answer") or {}).get("positions") or []))
            progress = asyncio.create_task(_progress(ctx))
            try:
                await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
            finally:
                progress.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(progress, return_exceptions=True)
            if phase == Phase.COLLECT:
                timeline.mark("collect end", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()))
                await _cancel_background(ctx)
                # Guard classification tasks are collection work too. None may survive into signing.
                pending = list(guard._TASKS)
                for t in pending:
                    t.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
                from agents import analyze_discount, analyze_materials, analyze_quantities, analyze_requirements
                await analyze_quantities.publish(ctx)
                await analyze_requirements.publish(ctx)
                await analyze_discount.publish(ctx)
                await analyze_materials.publish(ctx)
                log.info("board after collect (%.0fs left): %s", ctx.seconds_left(), board_summary(board))
            if not scored:
                board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
        log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
        if (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind", "api") != "api":
            receipt = board.get("submission") or {}
            if not receipt.get("accepted"):
                raise RuntimeError("No confirmed portal receipt; the run did not verify submission")
            log.info("portal acceptance confirmed: %s", receipt.get("reference"))
            return None                      # a "site" submission was entered by the submitter agent
        answer = board.get("answer")
        if answer is None:
            raise RuntimeError("No schema-valid API answer was produced")
        return answer
    finally:
        pending = list(guard._TASKS)
        for t in pending:
            t.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        await ctx.pool.close()
        if ctx.llm._client is not None:
            await ctx.llm._client.close()

"""Everything an agent gets: the task, the blackboard, the model, the browsers and the clock."""
import asyncio
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import run as contract
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.llm import LLM

# Collecting and analysing stop this long before expiry; the rest belongs to SUBMIT (filling the bid form and signing
# takes several minutes of browser steps). SUBMIT itself stops FINAL_MARGIN_S before expiry.
# signing 4 positions took 466 s in run_7732ba545b50b3a5 and ended 60 s before expiry; a 5th position adds ~90 s
SUBMIT_RESERVE_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S", 600))
FINAL_MARGIN_S = 40
# A scored run lasts 20 minutes; test runs may last 2 hours. Every run plans with at most RUN_LIMIT_S from process
# start, so test runs show the timing (and the follow-ups that fit) of a scored run. The run's real expiry still wins
# when it is earlier.
RUN_LIMIT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_RUN_LIMIT_S", 1200))


@dataclass
class Context:
    task: dict
    board: Blackboard
    llm: LLM
    pool: object                      # swarm.browser_pool.BrowserPool (None in unit tests)
    scored: bool = False              # True in a real run (has a run token); False for local scouting
    t0: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    monotonic_start: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
    _locks: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
    shared: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)   # in-memory objects agents share (queues); never dumped

    @property
    def brief(self) -> str:
        return self.task["brief"]

    def site(self, site_id: str) -> dict:
        """The access entry (siteId, url, credentials) of a website, e.g. ctx.site("erp")."""
        for entry in self.task["access"]:
            if entry.get("siteId") == site_id:
                return entry
        raise KeyError(f"no site {site_id!r}; have {[s.get('siteId') for s in self.task['access']]}")

    @property
    def site_ids(self) -> list[str]:
        return [s.get("siteId") for s in self.task["access"]]

    def seconds_left(self) -> float:
        left = contract.seconds_left(self.task)
        simulated = os.environ.get("SWARM_DEADLINE_S")          # local runs: pretend the run lasts this long
        if left == float("inf") and simulated and not self.scored:
            return float(simulated) - self.elapsed()
        return min(left, RUN_LIMIT_S - self.elapsed()) if RUN_LIMIT_S > 0 else left

    def time_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds of collecting/analysing left (run clock minus what SUBMIT needs)."""
        return self.seconds_left() - SUBMIT_RESERVE_S

    def elapsed(self) -> float:
        return time.monotonic() - self.monotonic_start

    def lock(self, name: str) -> asyncio.Lock:
        """A named lock shared by all agents of this run (e.g. so only one agent resolves the site roles)."""
        return self._locks.setdefault(name, asyncio.Lock())

async def _until_collect_ends(ctx, coro) -> None:
    """Run `coro` until it ends or the collect time is used up. The cutoff follows the live submission reserve (it
    moves with the measured pace), so it is re-checked every second rather than fixed when the phase starts."""
    task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
    try:
        while not task.done():
            left = ctx.time_left()
            if left <= 0:
                task.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
                raise asyncio.TimeoutError
            await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=min(1.0, max(0.05, left)))
        task.result()
    finally:
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)

        if kind.endswith(".page"):
            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    def time_for_retry(self, kwargs: dict, need: float = 120) -> bool:
        stop = kwargs["stop_reserve"] if kwargs.get("stop_reserve") is not None else self.ctx.stop_at(self.stop_extra(kwargs))
        return self.ctx.seconds_left() - stop >= need

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit, a crashed browser agent), start again
        with a note on what is already saved, while time allows. Saved pages are never collected twice."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
                timeline.count("browse.retries")
            try:
                out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed connection is one failed attempt, not the end
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"browse attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
                self.log.warning("browse attempt %d failed: %s", attempt + 1, error)
                out = {"summary": f"failed: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "records": [], "steps": 0}
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works
in the browser's main tab.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
        is already saved, while time allows."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
            if self.site_id in rejected:
                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
                out["done"] = False
            if out["done"] or self.ctx.seconds_left() - kwargs.get("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S) < 120:
                break
        return {**out, "records": records}

    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
            try:
                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
            finally:
                await tab.close()
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            for keywords, job in self.required():
                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)


def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked():
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once

def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)

Every message is read once:

   tabs (each logs in: this webmail keeps its login per tab). Messages already saved by another agent are not opened

The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
import os
import asyncio

from agents.analyze_discount import covered_topics, refresh
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S

from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper

TOPIC_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_MAIL_TABS", "2"))   # parallel mail topic tabs; was 3 (sandbox CPU)

    "Mailbox search combines words with AND and shows limited hits. Look-alike references (same reference with "
    "suffix) and other tenders do not count; drafts, previews, superseded mails look similar: read each candidate "
    "message. Read selected messages with ONE read_page(urls=[their links], topic '<topic> mail') (read_page also "
    "reads collapsed or locked parts, no need to unlock). Reading pane shows no message text -> use message's own "
    "page link. Skip signing-TAN mails.")

INDEX_JOB = (
    "Search the exact tender reference ALONE (no other word), first inbox then archive. read_page each result "
    "page with topic 'mail index'. On EACH result page, immediately read the matching message links before "
    "moving to another index page or folder; do not spend the entire budget collecting indexes. Prioritize "
    "discount approval and technical release messages from the authorized senders, then other commercial terms. "
    "Use read_page(urls=[observed message links], topic='mail messages'), up to 12 URLs. Return to the observed "
    "index URL to continue pagination. Read all messages for the exact reference, excluding look-alike suffixes, "
    "other tenders and signing TANs. Then done, listing subjects read.\n" + SEARCH_RULES)


@register

    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 24
    hints = ("Adapt to the observed software; these are possible patterns, not requirements. Webmail habits: cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close them, never follow their links); "
             "search may sit behind slider/robot gate: first try ONE fill_form (slider = its maximum, robot checkbox = "
             "true); still locked -> focus the slider and press End, or click its right end; never loop on evaluate; "
             "inbox and archive folder; paged result lists; message headers "
             "(sender, date) in collapsed 'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def browse(self, job: str, **kwargs):
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + 150)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)

        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})

        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Find mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}' in inbox and "
                        f"archive; read every matching message.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\nThen done.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            from agents.analyze_discount import publish
            valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

    "discount approval and technical release messages from the authorized senders, then other commercial terms. "
    "Use read_page(urls=[observed message links], topic='mail messages'), up to 12 URLs. Return to the observed "
    "index URL to continue pagination. Read all messages for the exact reference, excluding look-alike suffixes, "
    "other tenders and signing TANs. Then done, listing subjects read.\n" + SEARCH_RULES)


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 24
    hints = ("Adapt to the observed software; these are possible patterns, not requirements. Webmail habits: cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close them, never follow their links); "
             "search may sit behind slider/robot gate: first try ONE fill_form (slider = its maximum, robot checkbox = "
             "true); still locked -> focus the slider and press End, or click its right end; never loop on evaluate; "
             "inbox and archive folder; paged result lists; message headers "
             "(sender, date) in collapsed 'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def browse(self, job: str, **kwargs):
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)
        except Exception as error:
            self.log.warning("login browse failed: %s", error)

    def topic_jobs(self, facts: dict, covered: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})
        senders.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("director_sender") or "")
        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Find mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}' in inbox and "
                        f"archive; read every matching message.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\nThen done.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            from agents.analyze_discount import publish
            valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

    def test_unpriced_member_keeps_its_pool_share_and_makes_bonus_unknown(self):
        inputs = {
            'brief':{'tender_reference':'fixture','scenario_date':'2031-02-01'},
            'tender':{'positions':[{'position':p,'unit':'Stk'} for p in ('1','2')],
                      'clarifications':[{'positions':['1','2'],'keys':{'setup_pool':'S','bonus_plan':'B'}}]},
            'quantities':{'1':{'quantity':1},'2':{'quantity':1}},
            'materials':{'1':{'material':'M1'},'2':{'material':'M2'}},
            'erp':{'materials':{m:{'allocation_mass_g':'100','lead_time_production_weeks':'2'} for m in ('M1','M2')},
                   'conditions':[{'material':'M1','price_unit':'1','scales':[{'min_qty':'1','price':'100'}]}]},
            'mail':{'setup_pools':{'S':'20'},'project_bonus':{'B':[{'from':'0','percent':'10'}]}},
            'discount':{'percent':'5','min_order_value':'150'},
        }
        bid = compute(inputs)
        self.assertEqual(bid['answer']['positions'][0]['unit_price'], 110)

        bid = compute({'brief':{'tender_reference':'fixture'}, 'tender':{'positions':[{'position':'1'}]},
                       'materials':{'1':{'reason':'only blocked matches'}}, 'discount':{'percent':'5'}})
        self.assertEqual(bid['answer']['decision'], 'no_bid')

        self.assertIsNone(scale_price({'scales':[{'min_qty':1,'price':10}]}, 1))

    def test_scale_validity_and_allocation(self):
        cond = [{"material": "M-1", "valid_from": "01.01.2031", "valid_to": "31.03.2031, 23:59:59 UTC",
                 "price_unit": "10", "number_format": "en-US",
                 "scales": [{"min_qty": "1", "price": "1,000.00"}, {"min_qty": "20", "price": "900.00"}]}]
        c = valid_condition(cond, "M-1", to_datetime("2031-03-31T12:00:00Z"))

        self.assertIsNone(valid_condition(cond, "M-1", to_datetime("2031-04-01T00:00:01Z")))
        self.assertEqual(allocate_cents(Decimal("1.00"), {"a": Decimal(1), "b": Decimal(1), "c": Decimal(1)}),
                         {"a": Decimal("0.34"), "b": Decimal("0.33"), "c": Decimal("0.33")})

                                                         {"from": "100", "to": None, "percent": "10"}]), Decimal("5.00"))

    def test_full_bid(self):
        inputs = {
            "brief": {"tender_reference": "T-9", "scenario_date": "2031-02-01T09:00:00Z"},
            "tender": {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": "4", "unit": "Stk", "requirement_ref": "Z-1"},
                                     {"position": "2", "quantity": "2", "unit": "Satz", "requirement_ref": "Z-2"}],
                       "clarifications": [{"number": "5", "date": "2031-01-01", "positions": ["1"], "setup_fee": "10,00 EUR",
                                           "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": "K-1", "packaging_tariff": "P-1"}}]},
            "quantities": {"1": {"quantity": 4}, "2": {"quantity": 2}},
            "requirements": {"Z-1": {}, "Z-2": {"pieces_per_set": "3"}},
            "materials": {"1": {"material": "M-1"}, "2": {"material": "M-1"}},
            "erp": {"materials": {"M-1": {"pieces_per_carton": "3", "surcharge_mass_g": "500", "metal_index": "IX",
                                          "lead_time_stock_weeks": "2", "lead_time_production_weeks": "8"}},
                    "conditions": [{"material": "M-1", "valid_from": "2031-01-01", "valid_to": "2031-12-31",
                                    "price_unit": "1", "currency": "EUR", "scales": [{"min_qty": "1", "price": "100.00"}]}],
                    "stock": {"M-1": {"free": "10"}}},
            "discount": {"percent": "10", "min_order_value": "500"},
            "mail": {"condition_rules": {"K-1": "base_and_surcharge"}, "packaging_tariffs": {"P-1": "6"},
                     "price_indices": {"IX": "4"}},
        }
        bid = compute(inputs)
        answer = bid["answer"]
        p1, p2 = answer["positions"]
        # pos 1: base 100*0.9 + surcharge 2*0.9 + (setup 10 + 2 cartons*6)/4 = 90 + 1.8 + 5.5
        self.assertEqual(p1["unit_price"], 97.30)
        self.assertEqual(p1["surcharge_per_unit"], 4.50)
        self.assertEqual(p1["packaging_per_unit"], 3.00)
        # pos 2: 6 pieces, default base-only: 90 + 2
        self.assertEqual((p2["quantity"], p2["unit_price"]), (6, 92.00))
        self.assertEqual(p1["lead_time_weeks"], 2)          # pooled demand 4 + 6 = 10 <= 10 free: from stock
        self.assertEqual(answer["total_net"], round(4 * 97.30 + 6 * 92.00, 2))
        self.assertEqual(answer["discount_percent"], 10.0)
        inputs["erp"]["stock"]["M-1"]["free"] = "9"           # not enough for both: all-or-nothing -> production
        self.assertEqual({p["lead_time_weeks"] for p in compute(inputs)["answer"]["positions"]}, {8})

"""Semantic contracts across branches: two implementations of the same bid rules must agree.

The runtime prices with agents/compute_bid.py (from tender_portal); swarm/bidmath.py (from main / site-recon) holds the
same rules as small tested functions. A Git merge cannot see whether they agree, so this test feeds both the same
invented case, worked out by hand, and compares every field. Invented values only.
"""
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

from agents.compute_bid import compute
from swarm import bidmath as bm

# A hand-worked case: FX, a date-selected metal index, a base+surcharge clause, cartons, a shared setup pool, project
# bonus bands, a delivery commitment, shared stock and a conditional discount (10 % from 1000 EUR undiscounted).
EXPECTED = {
    "P1": {"quantity": 10, "unit_price": 87.31, "base_unit_price": 90.0, "surcharge_per_unit": 7.25,
           "packaging_per_unit": 0.9, "rebate_total": 14.43, "lead_time_weeks": 1},
    "P2": {"quantity": 10, "unit_price": 35.57, "base_unit_price": 36.0, "surcharge_per_unit": 3.75,
           "packaging_per_unit": 0.0, "rebate_total": 5.77, "lead_time_weeks": 3},
}
TOTAL, DISCOUNT = 1228.80, 10.0


def runtime_inputs() -> dict:
    """The case in the shapes compute() reads (results of tender_portal's analysts)."""
    return {
        "brief": {"tender_reference": "T-1", "scenario_date": "2030-03-10T09:00:00Z"},
        "tender": {"positions": [{"position": "P1", "unit": "Stück", "requirement_ref": "R1"},
                                 {"position": "P2", "unit": "Satz", "requirement_ref": "R2"}],
                   "clarifications": [
                       {"number": "1", "date": "2030-02-01", "positions": ["P1"], "setup_fee": "20",
                        "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": "K1", "packaging_tariff": "T1", "setup_pool": "POOL",
                                 "bonus_plan": "B"}},
                       {"number": "2", "date": "2030-02-01", "positions": ["P2"],
                        "keys": {"delivery_key": "C1", "setup_pool": "POOL", "bonus_plan": "B"}}]},
        "quantities": {"P1": {"quantity": 10}, "P2": {"quantity": 2}},
        "requirements": {"R1": {}, "R2": {"pieces_per_set": 5}},
        "materials": {"P1": {"material": "M1"}, "P2": {"material": "M2"}},
        "erp": {"materials": {"M1": {"pieces_per_carton": 4, "surcharge_mass_g": 2000, "metal_index": "AL",
                                     "allocation_mass_g": 1000, "lead_time_stock_weeks": 1,
                                     "lead_time_production_weeks": 6},
                              "M2": {"allocation_mass_g": 3000, "lead_time_stock_weeks": 1,
                                     "lead_time_production_weeks": 8, "surcharge_mass_g": 0, "metal_index": "AL"}},
                "conditions": [{"material": "M1", "valid_from": "2029-01-01", "valid_to": "2030-03-09", "price_unit": 1,
                                "scales": [{"min_qty": 1, "price": 999}]},
                               {"material": "M1", "valid_from": "2030-01-01", "valid_to": "2030-12-31", "price_unit": 1,
                                "scales": [{"min_qty": 1, "price": 100}, {"min_qty": 10, "price": 90}]},
                               {"material": "M2", "valid_from": "2030-01-01", "currency": "USD", "fx_key": "USD-1",
                                "price_unit": 1, "scales": [{"min_qty": 1, "price": 50}, {"min_qty": 10, "price": 40}]}],
                "stock": {"M1": {"free": 10}, "M2": {"free": 0}}},
        "discount": {"percent": "10", "min_order_value": "1000"},
        "mail": {"fx_by_key": {"USD-1": {"USD": "0.9"}}, "price_indices": {"AL": "2.0"},
                 "condition_rules": {"K1": "base_and_surcharge"}, "packaging_tariffs": {"T1": "3"},
                 "delivery_commitments": {"C1": {"material": "M2", "weeks": 3, "max_total_pieces": 10}},
                 "setup_pools": {"POOL": "50"},
                 "project_bonus": {"B": [{"from": 0, "to": 500, "percent": 1}, {"from": 500, "to": None, "percent": 2}]}},
    }


def bidmath_answer() -> dict:
    """The same case through bidmath's functions (the calculator in main's / tanreader-debug's pipeline)."""
    on = bm.date(2030, 3, 10)
    p1_base = bm.base_unit_price_eur([bm.Scale(1, 100), bm.Scale(10, 90)], 10)
    p2_base = bm.base_unit_price_eur([bm.Scale(1, 50), bm.Scale(10, 40)], 10, 1, Decimal("0.9"))
    rate = bm.rate_on([bm.RateWindow(Decimal("2.0"), bm.date(2030, 3, 1))], on)
    shares = bm.allocate_cents(50, {"P1": 10 * 1, "P2": 10 * 3})
    values = {"P1": 10 * p1_base, "P2": 10 * p2_base}
    credit = bm.marginal_credit(sum(values.values()), [bm.Band(0, 500, 1), bm.Band(500, None, 2)])
    bonus = bm.allocate_cents(credit, values)
    net = bm.undiscounted_net([(10, p1_base), (10, p2_base)])
    pct = bm.order_discount(10, 1000, net)
    p1 = bm.PositionFacts("P1", "M1", 10, p1_base, bm.lead_time_weeks(10, 10, 1, 6),
                          surcharge_per_piece=2 * rate, setup_fee=Decimal(20), shared_setup=shares["P1"],
                          carton_cost=bm.carton_cost(10, 4, 3), project_bonus=bonus["P1"], clause=bm.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE)
    p2 = bm.PositionFacts("P2", "M2", bm.final_pieces(2, "Satz", 5), p2_base, bm.lead_time_weeks(0, 10, 1, 8, 3, 10),
                          shared_setup=shares["P2"], project_bonus=bonus["P2"])
    return bm.answer(bm.Bid("T-1", discount_percent=pct, positions=[p1, p2]))


class PriceRulesAgree(unittest.TestCase):
    def check(self, answer: dict, who: str):
        self.assertEqual(answer["discount_percent"], DISCOUNT, who)
        self.assertEqual(answer["total_net"], TOTAL, who)
        got = {p["position"]: p for p in answer["positions"]}
        for pos, fields in EXPECTED.items():
            for name, value in fields.items():
                self.assertEqual(got[pos].get(name), value, f"{who}: {pos}.{name}")

    def test_runtime_calculator_matches_the_hand_worked_case(self):
        self.check(compute(runtime_inputs())["answer"], "agents/compute_bid.compute")

    def test_bidmath_matches_the_hand_worked_case(self):
        self.check(bidmath_answer(), "swarm.bidmath")

    def test_missing_price_unit_is_an_open_contract_question(self):
        """OPEN (docs/INTEGRATION.md): bidmath reads a missing price unit as 1; compute() deliberately prices nothing
        (tender_portal: tests/test_rules.py 'does_not_get_guessed'). This pins today's runtime behaviour."""
        inputs = runtime_inputs()
        for c in inputs["erp"]["conditions"]:
            c.pop("price_unit")
        self.assertEqual(compute(inputs)["answer"]["positions"], [])

    def test_explicit_price_unit_is_applied(self):
        inputs = runtime_inputs()
        inputs["erp"]["conditions"][1]["price_unit"] = 100
        p1 = {p["position"]: p for p in compute(inputs)["answer"]["positions"]}["P1"]
        self.assertEqual(p1["base_unit_price"], 0.9)                     # 90 per 100 pieces

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

@register
class BidCalculator(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COMPUTE

    async def run(self) -> None:
        names = ("brief", "tender", "quantities", "requirements", "materials", "erp", "discount", "mail")
        bid = compute({n: self.ctx.board.get(n) for n in names})
        from swarm.validation import answer_issues, prepare_answer
        original_positions = {p["position"] for p in bid["answer"]["positions"]}
        bid["answer"], repairs = prepare_answer(bid["answer"], self.ctx.task.get("answer_schema"))
        bid["issues"].extend(repairs)
        included = {p["position"] for p in bid["answer"]["positions"]}
        bid["omitted"] = sorted(set(bid["omitted"]) | (original_positions - included))
        bid["total_display"] = de_number(Decimal(str(bid["answer"]["total_net"])))
        errors = answer_issues(bid["answer"], self.ctx.task.get("answer_schema"))
        if errors:
            bid["issues"].extend(errors)
            self.ctx.board.error(self.name, "; ".join(errors))
        bid["validation_errors"] = errors
        await self.ctx.board.set("bid", bid)
        await self.ctx.board.set("answer", None if errors else bid["answer"])
        self.log.info("bid: %s omitted=%s issues=%s", bid["answer"], bid["omitted"], bid["issues"])

INPUTS = ("brief", "tender", "quantities", "requirements", "materials", "erp", "discount", "mail")


def build_bid(ctx) -> dict:
    """compute() on what the board holds now, made schema-valid (malformed lines omitted, total recomputed)."""
    bid = compute({n: ctx.board.get(n) for n in INPUTS})
    from swarm.validation import answer_issues, prepare_answer
    original_positions = {p["position"] for p in bid["answer"]["positions"]}
    bid["answer"], repairs = prepare_answer(bid["answer"], ctx.task.get("answer_schema"))
    bid["issues"].extend(repairs)
    included = {p["position"] for p in bid["answer"]["positions"]}
    bid["omitted"] = sorted(set(bid["omitted"]) | (original_positions - included))
    bid["total_display"] = de_number(Decimal(str(bid["answer"]["total_net"])))
    bid["validation_errors"] = answer_issues(bid["answer"], ctx.task.get("answer_schema"))
    bid["issues"].extend(bid["validation_errors"])
    bid["coverage"]["priced"] = len(included)
    return bid


@register
class BidCalculator(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COMPUTE

    async def run(self) -> None:
        bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
        errors = bid["validation_errors"]
        if errors:
            self.ctx.board.error(self.name, "; ".join(errors))
        await self.ctx.board.set("bid", bid)
        await self.ctx.board.set("answer", None if errors else bid["answer"])
        self.log.info("bid: %s omitted=%s issues=%s", bid["answer"], bid["omitted"], bid["issues"])
        self.log.info("bid fields: %s", {l["position"]: {k: v for k, v in (l.get("fields") or {}).items()
                                                         if v != "verified"} for l in bid["lines"]})

@register
class BidDrafter(Agent):
    """The bid as it would be submitted now, recomputed during collection (plain code, no model): a usable partial
    bid exists as soon as one position is priced, and its open dependencies tell the collectors what is still missing
    for each position (results["bid_draft"]). Milestones mark the first usable bid and complete coverage."""
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        from swarm import timeline
        last = None
        while True:
            try:
                bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a half-collected board must never stop the drafts
                self.log.debug("draft failed: %s", error)
                await asyncio.sleep(DRAFT_EVERY_S)
                continue
            cov = bid["coverage"]
            signature = (json.dumps(bid["answer"], sort_keys=True), json.dumps(bid["unresolved"], sort_keys=True))
            if signature != last:
                last = signature
                await self.ctx.board.set("bid_draft", bid)
                self.log.info("draft: %d/%d positions priced, %d complete, total %s; open: %s", cov["priced"],
                              cov["positions"], cov["complete"], bid["total_display"],
                              {p: ids for p, ids in bid["unresolved"].items()})
                if cov["priced"]:
                    timeline.mark("first usable bid", positions=cov["priced"])
                if cov["positions"] and cov["priced"] == cov["positions"]:
                    timeline.mark("all positions priced")
                if cov["positions"] and cov["complete"] == cov["positions"]:
                    timeline.mark("all positions complete")
                for pos in cov.get("complete_positions") or []:
                    timeline.mark(f"position {pos} complete")
            await asyncio.sleep(DRAFT_EVERY_S)

"""Agent base class and registry. One agent = one file in `agents/`, registered with @register."""
import enum
import logging
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class Phase(enum.IntEnum):
    COLLECT = 1   # scrapers: read the sites, post Evidence
    ANALYZE = 2   # analyzers: turn evidence into structured facts (quantities, requirements, candidate materials...)
    VERIFY = 3    # verifiers: cross-check authority / dates / tender reference / superseded records
    COMPUTE = 4   # calculators: deterministic arithmetic, set results["bid"]
    SUBMIT = 5    # fills the configurator, signs; ALWAYS runs, with reserved time


REGISTRY: list[type["Agent"]] = []


def register(cls):
    REGISTRY.append(cls)
    return cls


class Agent(ABC):
    name: str = ""               # defaults to the class name
    phase: Phase = Phase.COLLECT
    browser: int | None = None   # index of the browser this agent drives (0-3), None = no browser

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.name = self.name or type(self).__name__
        self.log = logging.getLogger(self.name)

    @abstractmethod
    async def run(self) -> None:
        """Read from `self.ctx.board`, do the work, write Evidence / results back. Raise on failure (it is logged;
        other agents carry on). Stop early when `self.ctx.time_left() <= 0`."""
